inventory.detail.title: 库存与目标明细分页
inventory.detail.notes: 日实存与目标键并集；库存缺行保持NULL，目标重复不任选；仅纠偏允许正值月初回补；滚动不回补。SKU编码精确连接，不自动去前导零。stock_date须属于month。源品类仅来自目标，不把品项当品类。目标粽子规则保留，缺日均需求不补0。目标月份不是目标采集时间。 known_*为已知值口径，须随missing_*显示部分；动销仍为源日均，不能赋给shipment30。；商品资料仅按唯一SKU匹配产品清单补空名称/物料组；同SKU字段冲突保留空，数量与日期范围不变。 D96业务确认：既有唯一版本聚合后的目标为空且同范围日均需求非负时，按日均需求×9派生展示目标；真实0不替换，日均需求缺失或重复版本保持未知；不回写上游。 D101：唯一基地/月/版本/SKU日均为空时，按同版本销售计划+调拨出库计划×0.5除该计划月自然天数补齐；缺任一要素或重复则保留未知；有效0保留。 D101/D114：同一基地与月份整体选版，纠偏→月初、月初→滚动；已选版本缺SKU、NULL、0或重复均不借用另一版本字段。

request.sql: WITH product_list_dictionary AS (SELECT t.material_code AS sku, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(t.material_name), '')) = 1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(t.material_name), '')) ELSE NULL END AS material_name, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(t.product_item_name), '')) = 1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(t.product_item_name), '')) ELSE NULL END AS material_group FROM agents_dim_product_list_mi AS t WHERE NOT NULLIF(TRIM(t.material_code), '') IS NULL GROUP BY t.material_code), order_material_dictionary AS (SELECT t.new_material_code AS sku, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT t.product_categ_name) = 1 AND COUNT(NULLIF(t.product_categ_name, '')) = COUNT(*) THEN MAX(t.product_categ_name) ELSE NULL END AS category, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT t.pinxiang) = 1 AND COUNT(NULLIF(t.pinxiang, '')) = COUNT(*) THEN MAX(t.pinxiang) ELSE NULL END AS item, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT t.material_group_name) = 1 AND COUNT(NULLIF(t.material_group_name, '')) = COUNT(*) THEN MAX(t.material_group_name) ELSE NULL END AS material_group FROM agents_order_execute_isontime_mi AS t WHERE NOT t.new_material_code IS NULL GROUP BY t.new_material_code), movement_material_dictionary AS (SELECT t.material_code AS sku, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT t.product_categ_name) = 1 AND COUNT(NULLIF(t.product_categ_name, '')) = COUNT(*) THEN MAX(t.product_categ_name) ELSE NULL END AS category, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT t.material_group_name) = 1 AND COUNT(NULLIF(t.material_group_name, '')) = COUNT(*) THEN MAX(t.material_group_name) ELSE NULL END AS material_group FROM agents_scm_material_in_out_summary_d AS t WHERE NOT t.material_code IS NULL GROUP BY t.material_code), material_dictionary AS (SELECT u.sku AS sku, COALESCE(MAX(u.order_category), MAX(u.movement_category)) AS category, MAX(u.item) AS item, COALESCE(MAX(u.order_group), MAX(u.movement_group)) AS material_group FROM (SELECT o.sku AS sku, o.category AS order_category, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS movement_category, o.item AS item, o.material_group AS order_group, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS movement_group FROM order_material_dictionary AS o UNION ALL SELECT m.sku AS sku, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS order_category, m.category AS movement_category, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS item, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS order_group, m.material_group AS movement_group FROM movement_material_dictionary AS m) AS u GROUP BY u.sku), target_source AS (SELECT t.year_month AS year_month, t.inventory_version AS inventory_version, t.belong_base AS belong_base, t.material_code AS material_code, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.material_name) ELSE NULL END AS material_name, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.product_categ_name) ELSE NULL END AS product_categ_name, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.product_tag) ELSE NULL END AS product_tag, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.current_inventory) ELSE NULL END AS current_inventory, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.turnover_inventory) ELSE NULL END AS turnover_inventory, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.safety_stock) ELSE NULL END AS safety_stock, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN COALESCE(MAX(t.avg_daily_planned_demand), CASE WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN t.inventory_version = '月初' THEN t.main_sales_plan_v1 WHEN t.inventory_version = '纠偏' THEN t.main_sales_plan_adj WHEN t.inventory_version = '滚动' THEN t.roll_sales_plan ELSE NULL END) >= 0 AND MAX(CASE WHEN t.inventory_version = '月初' THEN t.transfer_out_plan_v1 WHEN t.inventory_version = '纠偏' THEN t.transfer_out_plan_adj WHEN t.inventory_version = '滚动' THEN t.transfer_out_plan_roll ELSE NULL END) >= 0 THEN (MAX(CASE WHEN t.inventory_version = '月初' THEN t.main_sales_plan_v1 WHEN t.inventory_version = '纠偏' THEN t.main_sales_plan_adj WHEN t.inventory_version = '滚动' THEN t.roll_sales_plan ELSE NULL END) + MAX(CASE WHEN t.inventory_version = '月初' THEN t.transfer_out_plan_v1 WHEN t.inventory_version = '纠偏' THEN t.transfer_out_plan_adj WHEN t.inventory_version = '滚动' THEN t.transfer_out_plan_roll ELSE NULL END) * 0.5) / CAST(MAX(CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(t.year_month, 6, 2) = '02' THEN CASE WHEN CAST(SUBSTRING(t.year_month, 1, 4) AS INT) % 400 = 0 OR (CAST(SUBSTRING(t.year_month, 1, 4) AS INT) % 4 = 0 AND CAST(SUBSTRING(t.year_month, 1, 4) AS INT) % 100 <> 0) THEN 29 ELSE 28 END WHEN SUBSTRING(t.year_month, 6, 2) IN ('04', '06', '09', '11') THEN 30 ELSE 31 END) AS DECIMAL(20, 6)) ELSE NULL END) ELSE NULL END AS avg_daily_planned_demand, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.target_inventory) ELSE NULL END AS target_inventory, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.management_target_inventory) ELSE NULL END AS management_target_inventory, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.final_target_inventory) ELSE NULL END AS final_target_inventory, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.current_turnover_days) ELSE NULL END AS current_turnover_days, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.target_fill_rate) ELSE NULL END AS target_fill_rate, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.avg_30d_sale) ELSE NULL END AS avg_30d_sale, COUNT(*) AS source_rows FROM agents_scm_goods_inventory_turnover_data_m AS t WHERE t.year_month = :gea_p1 AND (t.inventory_version = :gea_p2 OR (:gea_p2 = '纠偏' AND t.inventory_version = '月初') OR (:gea_p2 = '月初' AND t.inventory_version = '滚动')) GROUP BY t.year_month, t.inventory_version, t.belong_base, t.material_code), target_versions AS (SELECT t.year_month AS year_month, t.belong_base AS belong_base, MIN(CASE WHEN t.inventory_version = :gea_p2 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS version_rank FROM target_source AS t GROUP BY t.year_month, t.belong_base), stock_source AS (SELECT t.data_month AS data_month, t.the_date AS the_date, t.belong_base AS belong_base, t.material_code AS material_code, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.material_name) ELSE NULL END AS material_name, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.product_item) ELSE NULL END AS product_item, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.series) ELSE NULL END AS series, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.spec) ELSE NULL END AS spec, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.channel_name) ELSE NULL END AS channel_name, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.current_stock) ELSE NULL END AS current_stock, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.available_stock) ELSE NULL END AS available_stock, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.current_stock_60) ELSE NULL END AS current_stock_60, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.allocated_qty) ELSE NULL END AS allocated_qty, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.ordered_qty) ELSE NULL END AS ordered_qty, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.pre_order_qty) ELSE NULL END AS pre_order_qty, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.avg_30d_send) ELSE NULL END AS avg_30d_send, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.avg_30d_sale) ELSE NULL END AS avg_30d_sale, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.begin_stock) ELSE NULL END AS begin_stock, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.month_plan_qty) ELSE NULL END AS month_plan_qty, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.month_order_qty) ELSE NULL END AS month_order_qty, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.next_month_out_plan) ELSE NULL END AS next_month_out_plan, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.next_month_sales_plan) ELSE NULL END AS next_month_sales_plan, COUNT(*) AS source_rows FROM agents_scm_stock_detail_d AS t WHERE t.data_month = CAST(:gea_p90 AS DATE) AND t.the_date = :gea_p3 GROUP BY t.data_month, t.the_date, t.belong_base, t.material_code), targets AS (SELECT t.belong_base AS base, t.material_code AS sku, t.inventory_version AS effective_version, t.material_name AS material_name, t.product_categ_name AS product_categ_name, t.product_tag AS product_tag, t.current_inventory AS current_inventory, t.turnover_inventory AS turnover_inventory, t.safety_stock AS safety_stock, t.avg_daily_planned_demand AS avg_daily_planned_demand, t.target_inventory AS target_inventory, t.management_target_inventory AS management_target_inventory, t.final_target_inventory AS final_target_inventory, t.current_turnover_days AS current_turnover_days, t.target_fill_rate AS target_fill_rate, t.avg_30d_sale AS avg_30d_sale, t.source_rows AS target_rows FROM target_source AS t INNER JOIN target_versions AS v ON t.year_month = v.year_month AND t.belong_base = v.belong_base AND CASE WHEN t.inventory_version = :gea_p2 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END = v.version_rank), inventory_keys AS (SELECT t.base AS base, t.sku AS sku FROM targets AS t UNION ALL SELECT s.belong_base AS base, s.material_code AS sku FROM stock_source AS s LEFT JOIN targets AS t ON t.base = s.belong_base AND t.sku = s.material_code WHERE t.sku IS NULL), aligned AS (SELECT k.base AS base, k.sku AS sku, :gea_p1 AS month, :gea_p3 AS stock_date, t.effective_version AS effective_version, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(s.material_name, t.material_name)), ''), pm.material_name) AS material_name, COALESCE(NULLIF(t.product_categ_name, ''), d.category) AS category, COALESCE(NULLIF(s.product_item, ''), d.item) AS item, s.series AS series, s.channel_name AS channel, t.product_tag AS product_tag, s.current_stock AS inventory, s.available_stock AS available, s.current_stock_60 AS over60, t.avg_daily_planned_demand AS daily_demand, t.safety_stock AS safety_stock, t.turnover_inventory AS turnover_inventory, t.target_inventory AS initial_target, t.management_target_inventory AS management_target, t.final_target_inventory AS final_target, CASE WHEN t.final_target_inventory = 0 THEN 0 ELSE COALESCE(CASE WHEN t.sku IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN t.product_categ_name = '粽子' OR t.product_tag LIKE '%粽子%' OR t.material_name LIKE '%粽子%' THEN CASE WHEN t.avg_daily_planned_demand IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN t.avg_daily_planned_demand > 0 THEN t.turnover_inventory ELSE 0 END ELSE t.final_target_inventory END, CASE WHEN t.avg_daily_planned_demand >= 0 THEN t.avg_daily_planned_demand * 9 ELSE NULL END) END AS target, t.avg_30d_sale AS target_avg_30d_sale, s.avg_30d_sale AS stock_avg_30d_sale, s.allocated_qty AS allocated, s.ordered_qty AS ordered, COALESCE(t.target_rows, 0) AS target_source_rows, COALESCE(s.source_rows, 0) AS stock_source_rows FROM inventory_keys AS k LEFT JOIN targets AS t ON t.base = k.base AND t.sku = k.sku LEFT JOIN stock_source AS s ON s.belong_base = k.base AND s.material_code = k.sku LEFT JOIN material_dictionary AS d ON d.sku = k.sku LEFT JOIN product_list_dictionary AS pm ON pm.sku = k.sku), business_rows AS (SELECT a.base AS base, a.sku AS sku, a.month AS month, a.stock_date AS stock_date, a.effective_version AS effective_version, a.material_name AS material_name, a.category AS category, a.item AS item, a.series AS series, a.channel AS channel, a.product_tag AS product_tag, a.inventory AS inventory, a.available AS available, a.over60 AS over60, a.daily_demand AS daily_demand, a.safety_stock AS safety_stock, a.turnover_inventory AS turnover_inventory, a.initial_target AS initial_target, a.management_target AS management_target, a.final_target AS final_target, a.target AS target, a.target_avg_30d_sale AS target_avg_30d_sale, a.stock_avg_30d_sale AS stock_avg_30d_sale, a.allocated AS allocated, a.ordered AS ordered, a.target_source_rows AS target_source_rows, a.stock_source_rows AS stock_source_rows, a.inventory - a.target AS gap, CASE WHEN a.inventory IS NULL OR a.target IS NULL THEN 'unknown' WHEN a.inventory < a.target THEN 'low' WHEN a.inventory > a.target THEN 'high' ELSE 'normal' END AS risk FROM aligned AS a), filtered AS (SELECT r.base AS base, r.sku AS sku, r.month AS month, r.stock_date AS stock_date, r.effective_version AS effective_version, r.material_name AS material_name, r.category AS category, r.item AS item, r.series AS series, r.channel AS channel, r.product_tag AS product_tag, r.inventory AS inventory, r.available AS available, r.over60 AS over60, r.daily_demand AS daily_demand, r.safety_stock AS safety_stock, r.turnover_inventory AS turnover_inventory, r.initial_target AS initial_target, r.management_target AS management_target, r.final_target AS final_target, r.target AS target, r.target_avg_30d_sale AS target_avg_30d_sale, r.stock_avg_30d_sale AS stock_avg_30d_sale, r.allocated AS allocated, r.ordered AS ordered, r.target_source_rows AS target_source_rows, r.stock_source_rows AS stock_source_rows, r.gap AS gap, r.risk AS risk FROM business_rows AS r WHERE (:gea_p4 = FALSE OR r.base IN (:gea_p5)) AND (:gea_p6 = 'all' OR (:gea_p6 = 'equal' AND r.sku = :gea_p7) OR (:gea_p6 = 'missing' AND r.sku IS NULL)) AND (:gea_p8 = 'all' OR (:gea_p8 = 'equal' AND r.category = :gea_p9) OR (:gea_p8 = 'missing' AND r.category IS NULL)) AND (:gea_p10 = 'all' OR (:gea_p10 = 'equal' AND r.item = :gea_p11) OR (:gea_p10 = 'missing' AND r.item IS NULL)) AND (:gea_p12 = 'all' OR (:gea_p12 = 'equal' AND r.series = :gea_p13) OR (:gea_p12 = 'missing' AND r.series IS NULL)) AND (:gea_p14 = 'all' OR (:gea_p14 = 'equal' AND r.channel = :gea_p15) OR (:gea_p14 = 'missing' AND r.channel IS NULL)) AND (:gea_p16 = 'all' OR (:gea_p16 = 'equal' AND r.risk = :gea_p17) OR (:gea_p16 = 'missing' AND r.risk IS NULL)) AND (:gea_p18 IS NULL OR LOWER(r.sku) LIKE LOWER(:gea_p18) OR LOWER(r.material_name) LIKE LOWER(:gea_p18) OR LOWER(r.category) LIKE LOWER(:gea_p18)) AND (:gea_p19 IS NULL OR r.category IS NULL OR r.category <> :gea_p19)) SELECT r.base AS base, r.sku AS sku, r.month AS month, r.stock_date AS stock_date, r.effective_version AS effective_version, r.material_name AS material_name, r.category AS category, r.item AS item, r.series AS series, r.channel AS channel, r.product_tag AS product_tag, r.inventory AS inventory, r.available AS available, r.over60 AS over60, r.daily_demand AS daily_demand, r.safety_stock AS safety_stock, r.turnover_inventory AS turnover_inventory, r.initial_target AS initial_target, r.management_target AS management_target, r.final_target AS final_target, r.target AS target, r.target_avg_30d_sale AS target_avg_30d_sale, r.stock_avg_30d_sale AS stock_avg_30d_sale, r.allocated AS allocated, r.ordered AS ordered, r.target_source_rows AS target_source_rows, r.stock_source_rows AS stock_source_rows, r.gap AS gap, r.risk AS risk FROM filtered AS r WHERE SUBSTRING(:gea_p3, 1, 7) = SUBSTRING(:gea_p90, 1, 7) ORDER BY CASE WHEN :gea_p22 = 'gap' AND r.gap IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ASC, CASE WHEN :gea_p22 = 'gap' AND :gea_p23 = 'asc' THEN r.gap ELSE NULL END ASC, CASE WHEN :gea_p22 = 'gap' AND :gea_p23 = 'desc' THEN r.gap ELSE NULL END DESC, CASE WHEN :gea_p22 = 'inventory' AND r.inventory IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ASC, CASE WHEN :gea_p22 = 'inventory' AND :gea_p23 = 'asc' THEN r.inventory ELSE NULL END ASC, CASE WHEN :gea_p22 = 'inventory' AND :gea_p23 = 'desc' THEN r.inventory ELSE NULL END DESC, CASE WHEN :gea_p22 = 'target' AND r.target IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ASC, CASE WHEN :gea_p22 = 'target' AND :gea_p23 = 'asc' THEN r.target ELSE NULL END ASC, CASE WHEN :gea_p22 = 'target' AND :gea_p23 = 'desc' THEN r.target ELSE NULL END DESC, CASE WHEN :gea_p22 = 'safety_stock' AND r.safety_stock IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ASC, CASE WHEN :gea_p22 = 'safety_stock' AND :gea_p23 = 'asc' THEN r.safety_stock ELSE NULL END ASC, CASE WHEN :gea_p22 = 'safety_stock' AND :gea_p23 = 'desc' THEN r.safety_stock ELSE NULL END DESC, CASE WHEN :gea_p22 = 'turnover_inventory' AND r.turnover_inventory IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ASC, CASE WHEN :gea_p22 = 'turnover_inventory' AND :gea_p23 = 'asc' THEN r.turnover_inventory ELSE NULL END ASC, CASE WHEN :gea_p22 = 'turnover_inventory' AND :gea_p23 = 'desc' THEN r.turnover_inventory ELSE NULL END DESC, r.base ASC, r.sku ASC LIMIT :gea_p20 OFFSET :gea_p21

inventory.summary.title: 库存与目标全范围汇总
inventory.summary.notes: 日实存与目标键并集；库存缺行保持NULL，目标重复不任选；仅纠偏允许正值月初回补；滚动不回补。SKU编码精确连接，不自动去前导零。stock_date须属于month。源品类仅来自目标，不把品项当品类。目标粽子规则保留，缺日均需求不补0。目标月份不是目标采集时间。 known_*为已知值口径，须随missing_*显示部分；动销仍为源日均，不能赋给shipment30。 汇总不受列表分页参数影响。；商品资料仅按唯一SKU匹配产品清单补空名称/物料组；同SKU字段冲突保留空，数量与日期范围不变。 D96业务确认：既有唯一版本聚合后的目标为空且同范围日均需求非负时，按日均需求×9派生展示目标；真实0不替换，日均需求缺失或重复版本保持未知；不回写上游。 D101：唯一基地/月/版本/SKU日均为空时，按同版本销售计划+调拨出库计划×0.5除该计划月自然天数补齐；缺任一要素或重复则保留未知；有效0保留。 D101/D114：同一基地与月份整体选版，纠偏→月初、月初→滚动；已选版本缺SKU、NULL、0或重复均不借用另一版本字段。

inventory.groups.title: 库存与目标分层汇总分页
inventory.groups.notes: 日实存与目标键并集；库存缺行保持NULL，目标重复不任选；仅纠偏允许正值月初回补；滚动不回补。SKU编码精确连接，不自动去前导零。stock_date须属于month。源品类仅来自目标，不把品项当品类。目标粽子规则保留，缺日均需求不补0。目标月份不是目标采集时间。 known_*为已知值口径，须随missing_*显示部分；动销仍为源日均，不能赋给shipment30。；商品资料仅按唯一SKU匹配产品清单补空名称/物料组；同SKU字段冲突保留空，数量与日期范围不变。 D96业务确认：既有唯一版本聚合后的目标为空且同范围日均需求非负时，按日均需求×9派生展示目标；真实0不替换，日均需求缺失或重复版本保持未知；不回写上游。 D101：唯一基地/月/版本/SKU日均为空时，按同版本销售计划+调拨出库计划×0.5除该计划月自然天数补齐；缺任一要素或重复则保留未知；有效0保留。 D101/D114：同一基地与月份整体选版，纠偏→月初、月初→滚动；已选版本缺SKU、NULL、0或重复均不借用另一版本字段。

inventory.options_count.title: 库存与目标筛选选项数
inventory.options_count.notes: 日实存与目标键并集；库存缺行保持NULL，目标重复不任选；仅纠偏允许正值月初回补；滚动不回补。SKU编码精确连接，不自动去前导零。stock_date须属于month。源品类仅来自目标，不把品项当品类。目标粽子规则保留，缺日均需求不补0。目标月份不是目标采集时间。 known_*为已知值口径，须随missing_*显示部分；动销仍为源日均，不能赋给shipment30。；商品资料仅按唯一SKU匹配产品清单补空名称/物料组；同SKU字段冲突保留空，数量与日期范围不变。 D96业务确认：既有唯一版本聚合后的目标为空且同范围日均需求非负时，按日均需求×9派生展示目标；真实0不替换，日均需求缺失或重复版本保持未知；不回写上游。 D101：唯一基地/月/版本/SKU日均为空时，按同版本销售计划+调拨出库计划×0.5除该计划月自然天数补齐；缺任一要素或重复则保留未知；有效0保留。 D101/D114：同一基地与月份整体选版，纠偏→月初、月初→滚动；已选版本缺SKU、NULL、0或重复均不借用另一版本字段。

turnover_inventory, t.target_inventory AS initial_target, t.management_target_inventory AS management_target, t.final_target_inventory AS final_target, CASE WHEN t.final_target_inventory = 0 THEN 0 ELSE COALESCE(CASE WHEN t.sku IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN t.product_categ_name = '粽子' OR t.product_tag LIKE '%粽子%' OR t.material_name LIKE '%粽子%' THEN CASE WHEN t.avg_daily_planned_demand IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN t.avg_daily_planned_demand > 0 THEN t.turnover_inventory ELSE 0 END ELSE t.final_target_inventory END, CASE WHEN t.avg_daily_planned_demand >= 0 THEN t.avg_daily_planned_demand * 9 ELSE NULL END) END AS target, t.avg_30d_sale AS target_avg_30d_sale, s.avg_30d_sale AS stock_avg_30d_sale, s.allocated_qty AS allocated, s.ordered_qty AS ordered, COALESCE(t.target_rows, 0) AS target_source_rows, COALESCE(s.source_rows, 0) AS stock_source_rows FROM inventory_keys AS k LEFT JOIN targets AS t ON t.base = k.base AND t.sku = k.sku LEFT JOIN stock_source AS s ON s.belong_base = k.base AND s.material_code = k.sku LEFT JOIN material_dictionary AS d ON d.sku = k.sku LEFT JOIN product_list_dictionary AS pm ON pm.sku = k.sku), business_rows AS (SELECT a.base AS base, a.sku AS sku, a.month AS month, a.stock_date AS stock_date, a.effective_version AS effective_version, a.material_name AS material_name, a.category AS category, a.item AS item, a.series AS series, a.channel AS channel, a.product_tag AS product_tag, a.inventory AS inventory, a.available AS available, a.over60 AS over60, a.daily_demand AS daily_demand, a.safety_stock AS safety_stock, a.turnover_inventory AS turnover_inventory, a.initial_target AS initial_target, a.management_target AS management_target, a.final_target AS final_target, a.target AS target, a.target_avg_30d_sale AS target_avg_30d_sale, a.stock_avg_30d_sale AS stock_avg_30d_sale, a.allocated AS allocated, a.ordered AS ordered, a.target_source_rows AS target_source_rows, a.stock_source_rows AS stock_source_rows, a.inventory - a.target AS gap, CASE WHEN a.inventory IS NULL OR a.target IS NULL THEN 'unknown' WHEN a.inventory < a.target THEN 'low' WHEN a.inventory > a.target THEN 'high' ELSE 'normal' END AS risk FROM aligned AS a), filtered AS (SELECT r.base AS base, r.sku AS sku, r.month AS month, r.stock_date AS stock_date, r.effective_version AS effective_version, r.material_name AS material_name, r.category AS category, r.item AS item, r.series AS series, r.channel AS channel, r.product_tag AS product_tag, r.inventory AS inventory, r.available AS available, r.over60 AS over60, r.daily_demand AS daily_demand, r.safety_stock AS safety_stock, r.turnover_inventory AS turnover_inventory, r.initial_target AS initial_target, r.management_target AS management_target, r.final_target AS final_target, r.target AS target, r.target_avg_30d_sale AS target_avg_30d_sale, r.stock_avg_30d_sale AS stock_avg_30d_sale, r.allocated AS allocated, r.ordered AS ordered, r.target_source_rows AS target_source_rows, r.stock_source_rows AS stock_source_rows, r.gap AS gap, r.risk AS risk FROM business_rows AS r WHERE (:gea_p4 = FALSE OR r.base IN (:gea_p5)) AND (:gea_p6 = 'all' OR (:gea_p6 = 'equal' AND r.sku = :gea_p7) OR (:gea_p6 = 'missing' AND r.sku IS NULL)) AND (:gea_p8 = 'all' OR (:gea_p8 = 'equal' AND r.category = :gea_p9) OR (:gea_p8 = 'missing' AND r.category IS NULL)) AND (:gea_p10 = 'all' OR (:gea_p10 = 'equal' AND r.item = :gea_p11) OR (:gea_p10 = 'missing' AND r.item IS NULL)) AND (:gea_p12 = 'all' OR (:gea_p12 = 'equal' AND r.series = :gea_p13) OR (:gea_p12 = 'missing' AND r.series IS NULL)) AND (:gea_p14 = 'all' OR (:gea_p14 = 'equal' AND r.channel = :gea_p15) OR (:gea_p14 = 'missing' AND r.channel IS NULL)) AND (:gea_p16 = 'all' OR (:gea_p16 = 'equal' AND r.risk = :gea_p17) OR (:gea_p16 = 'missing' AND r.risk IS NULL)) AND (:gea_p18 IS NULL OR LOWER(r.sku) LIKE LOWER(:gea_p18) OR LOWER(r.material_name) LIKE LOWER(:gea_p18) OR LOWER(r.category) LIKE LOWER(:gea_p18)) AND (:gea_p19 IS NULL OR r.category IS NULL OR r.category <> :gea_p19)) SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN :gea_p25 = 'base' THEN CAST(r.base AS VARCHAR) WHEN :gea_p25 = 'category' THEN CAST(r.category AS VARCHAR) WHEN :gea_p25 = 'item' THEN CAST(r.item AS VARCHAR) WHEN :gea_p25 = 'series' THEN CAST(r.series AS VARCHAR) WHEN :gea_p25 = 'sku' THEN CAST(r.sku AS VARCHAR) ELSE NULL END AS option_value, COUNT(*) AS row_count FROM filtered AS r GROUP BY CASE WHEN :gea_p25 = 'base' THEN CAST(r.base AS VARCHAR) WHEN :gea_p25 = 'category' THEN CAST(r.category AS VARCHAR) WHEN :gea_p25 = 'item' THEN CAST(r.item AS VARCHAR) WHEN :gea_p25 = 'series' THEN CAST(r.series AS VARCHAR) WHEN :gea_p25 = 'sku' THEN CAST(r.sku AS VARCHAR) ELSE NULL END) AS o WHERE SUBSTRING(:gea_p3, 1, 7) = SUBSTRING(:gea_p90, 1, 7)

orders.detail.title: 订单业务期事实明细分页
orders.detail.notes: 分仓向基地下单以ASN调拨入库为主体，warehouseid为收货分仓，source_warehouseid关联基地；状态00为未收货、90排除、99完成。按CRM源单号、来源仓、收货分仓和SKU关联基地出库单，出库占用按业务单位转换率换为件；ASN预期及实收原值为件。当前订单为ASN未收货量，基地占用扣除已收货并受当前需求上限约束。缺货按订单剩余需求、基地与SKU共享可用库存计算，按订单创建时间/执行单号/分仓编码稳定先后分配；分仓、SKU、搜索及分页在分配后筛选。缺失或冲突保持未知。

request.sql:
WITH upstream_snapshot AS (
 SELECT MAX(i.month_date) AS month_date FROM agents_scm_inventory_sku_data_d AS i
 WHERE i.warehouse_classify IN ('01','02','20')
), latest_inventory AS (SELECT s.month_date AS month_date FROM upstream_snapshot AS s),
upstream_warehouses AS (
 SELECT i.warehouseid AS warehouse_code, MAX(i.warehouse_name) AS warehouse_name
 FROM agents_scm_inventory_sku_data_d AS i INNER JOIN upstream_snapshot AS s ON i.month_date=s.month_date
 WHERE (i.warehouse_classify='20' OR i.warehouseid='N436')
 GROUP BY i.warehouseid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT i.warehouse_name)=1
), upstream_base_batches AS (
 SELECT i.belong_base AS base,i.material_code AS sku,i.warehouseid AS warehouse_code,
 i.prod_date AS prod_date,i.sap_warehouseid AS sap_warehouseid,i.plant AS plant,
 i.quality_batch AS quality_batch,i.is_good_prod AS is_good_prod,i.warehouse_classify AS warehouse_classify,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=1 AND COUNT(i.available_qty)=1 THEN SUM(i.available_qty) END AS available
 FROM agents_scm_inventory_sku_data_d AS i INNER JOIN upstream_snapshot AS s ON i.month_date=s.month_date
 WHERE i.warehouse_classify IN ('01','02') AND i.warehouseid<>'N436'
 GROUP BY i.belong_base,i.material_code,i.warehouseid,i.prod_date,i.sap_warehouseid,i.plant,i.quality_batch,i.is_good_prod,i.warehouse_classify
) , upstream_bases AS (
 SELECT b.base AS base FROM upstream_base_batches AS b GROUP BY b.base
), upstream_base_stock AS (
 SELECT b.base AS base,b.sku AS sku,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(b.available)=COUNT(*) THEN CASE WHEN SUM(b.available)>0 THEN SUM(b.available) ELSE 0 END END AS available
 FROM upstream_base_batches AS b GROUP BY b.base,b.sku
), upstream_base_warehouses AS (
 SELECT b.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code,CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT b.base)=1 THEN MAX(b.base) END AS base
 FROM upstream_base_batches AS b GROUP BY b.warehouse_code
), asn_lines AS (
 SELECT a.warehouseid AS warehouse_code,a.source_warehouseid AS source_wh,a.asnreference1 AS source_order,
 a.asnno AS asn_no,a.asnlineno AS line_no,a.material_code AS sku,
 MAX(a.warehouse_name) AS warehouse_name,MIN(a.header_addtime) AS created_at,
 MIN(a.actualarrivetime) AS requested_at,MAX(a.order_close_time) AS asn_closed_at,MAX(a.asnstatus) AS asn_status,
 MAX(a.lastreceivingtime) AS received_at,MAX(a.load_time) AS source_updated_at,COUNT(*) AS physical_rows,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=1 AND MIN(a.expectedqty)>=0 THEN MAX(a.expectedqty) END AS expected,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=1 AND MIN(a.receivedqty)>=0 THEN MAX(a.receivedqty) END AS received
 FROM agents_scm_asn_detail_d AS a
 WHERE (a.warehouse_classify='20' OR a.warehouseid='N436') AND a.asntype IN ('TT','COMPANY_SALE')
 AND a.asnstatus IN ('00','99') AND a.header_addtime<CAST(:gea_p2 AS DATE) AND (a.order_close_time>=CAST(:gea_p1 AS DATE) OR a.order_close_time IS NULL)
 GROUP BY a.warehouseid,a.source_warehouseid,a.asnreference1,a.asnno,a.asnlineno,a.material_code
), asn_orders AS (
 SELECT a.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code,a.source_wh AS source_wh,a.source_order AS source_order,a.sku AS sku,
 MAX(a.warehouse_name) AS warehouse_name,MIN(a.created_at) AS created_at,MIN(a.requested_at) AS requested_at,
 MAX(a.asn_closed_at) AS asn_closed_at,MAX(a.asn_status) AS asn_status,MAX(a.received_at) AS received_at,
 MAX(a.source_updated_at) AS source_updated_at,MIN(a.asn_no) AS fallback_no,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(a.expected)=COUNT(*) THEN SUM(a.expected) END AS expected,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(a.received)=COUNT(*) THEN SUM(a.received) END AS received,
 MAX(CASE WHEN a.physical_rows<>1 OR a.source_order IS NULL OR a.expected IS NULL OR a.received IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS invalid
 FROM asn_lines AS a GROUP BY a.warehouse_code,a.source_wh,a.source_order,a.sku
), asn_execution_keys AS (
 SELECT a.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code,a.source_wh AS source_wh,a.source_order AS source_order,a.sku AS sku
 FROM asn_orders AS a GROUP BY a.warehouse_code,a.source_wh,a.source_order,a.sku
), asn_execution_lines AS (
 SELECT k.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code,k.source_wh AS source_wh,k.source_order AS source_order,k.sku AS sku,
 e.executeorderno AS execute_order,e.executeorderlineno AS line_no,MAX(e.material_name) AS material_name,
 MAX(e.prapare_order_status) AS prepare_status,MAX(e.wms_close_time) AS shipped_at,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=1 AND MIN(e.qtyallocated)>=0 AND MIN(e.bizunitconvertrate)>0 THEN MAX(e.qtyallocated/e.bizunitconvertrate) END AS allocated,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=1 AND MIN(e.qtyshipped)>=0 AND MIN(e.bizunitconvertrate)>0 THEN MAX(e.qtyshipped/e.bizunitconvertrate) END AS shipped
 FROM asn_execution_keys AS k INNER JOIN agents_scm_execute_detail_hourly_d AS e
 ON e.fromorderno=k.source_order AND e.receive_wh=k.warehouse_code AND e.warehouseid=k.source_wh AND e.material_code=k.sku
 WHERE e.order_type='ZUB' AND e.detailstatus=10 AND NULLIF(TRIM(e.canceltime),'') IS NULL AND NULLIF(TRIM(e.dmscanceltime),'') IS NULL
 GROUP BY k.warehouse_code,k.source_wh,k.source_order,k.sku,e.executeorderno,e.executeorderlineno
), asn_execution AS (
 SELECT e.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code,e.source_wh AS source_wh,e.source_order AS source_order,e.sku AS sku,
 MAX(e.material_name) AS material_name,MAX(e.shipped_at) AS shipped_at,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT e.prepare_status)=1 THEN MAX(e.prepare_status) END AS prepare_status,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(e.allocated)=COUNT(*) THEN SUM(e.allocated) END AS allocated,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(e.shipped)=COUNT(*) THEN SUM(e.shipped) END AS shipped
 FROM asn_execution_lines AS e GROUP BY e.warehouse_code,e.source_wh,e.source_order,e.sku
), upstream_raw_lines AS (
 SELECT a.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code,a.warehouse_name AS warehouse_name,b.base AS base,
 COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(a.source_order),''),a.fallback_no) AS order_no,a.sku AS line_no,a.sku AS sku,
 e.material_name AS material_name,a.created_at AS created_at,a.requested_at AS requested_at,
 e.shipped_at AS completed_at,a.asn_closed_at AS closed_at,
 CASE WHEN a.asn_status='00' THEN '待收货' ELSE '已收货' END AS order_status,
 a.asn_status AS asn_status,e.prepare_status AS prepare_status,a.expected AS expected_total,a.received AS received_total,
 CASE WHEN e.allocated IS NOT NULL AND a.expected IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN e.allocated>a.expected THEN a.expected ELSE e.allocated END END AS allocated_total,
 a.source_updated_at AS source_updated_at,CASE WHEN a.invalid=0 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS source_rows,
 CASE WHEN a.expected IS NULL OR a.received IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN a.expected>a.received THEN a.expected-a.received ELSE 0 END AS ordered,
 CASE WHEN e.allocated IS NULL OR a.expected IS NULL OR a.received IS NULL THEN NULL
 WHEN e.allocated<=a.received THEN 0 WHEN e.allocated>=a.expected THEN CASE WHEN a.expected>a.received THEN a.expected-a.received ELSE 0 END ELSE e.allocated-a.received END AS allocated,
 CASE WHEN e.shipped IS NULL OR a.expected IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN e.shipped>a.expected THEN a.expected ELSE e.shipped END AS shipped
 FROM asn_orders AS a LEFT JOIN asn_execution AS e
 ON a.warehouse_code=e.warehouse_code AND a.source_wh=e.source_wh AND a.source_order=e.source_order AND a.sku=e.sku
 LEFT JOIN upstream_base_warehouses AS b ON a.source_wh=b.warehouse_code
 LEFT JOIN upstream_warehouses AS sender ON a.source_wh=sender.warehouse_code
 WHERE sender.warehouse_code IS NULL
), upstream_presence AS (
 SELECT COUNT(*) AS source_count FROM (SELECT 1 AS present FROM agents_scm_asn_detail_d AS a LIMIT 1) AS p
), upstream_monthly_materials AS (SELECT m.material_code AS sku,CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(m.product_categ_name),''))=1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(m.product_categ_name),'')) END AS category,CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(m.material_group_name),''))=1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(m.material_group_name),'')) END AS material_group FROM agents_scm_material_in_out_summary_d AS m GROUP BY m.material_code), upstream_shipped_orders AS (SELECT l.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code,l.order_no AS order_no FROM upstream_raw_lines AS l WHERE l.completed_at>=CAST(:gea_p1 AS DATE) AND l.completed_at<CAST(:gea_p2 AS DATE) GROUP BY l.warehouse_code,l.order_no HAVING SUM(l.shipped)>0 OR COUNT(l.shipped)<>COUNT(*)), source_records AS (SELECT l.order_no AS fromorderno,l.base AS belong_base,'分仓' AS pick_point_type2,
 l.warehouse_code AS pickup_point,l.warehouse_name AS pickup_point_name,l.base AS cust_code,l.base AS cust_name,
 l.sku AS new_material_code,l.material_name AS new_material_name,
 CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(255)) AS region_name,CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(255)) AS province_region_name,
 CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(255)) AS sales_group_name,CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(255)) AS xilie,CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(255)) AS pinxiang,
 a.material_group AS material_group_name,a.category AS product_categ_name,
 l.created_at AS fromorderno_month,l.created_at AS header_addtime,l.order_no AS executeorderno,
 l.completed_at AS complete_time,CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(255)) AS is_ontime,l.source_rows AS source_rows,
 l.expected_total AS order_qty_origin,l.expected_total AS need_qty_origin,l.allocated_total AS pack_unitqty,l.shipped AS qtyshipped,
 CASE WHEN l.expected_total IS NULL OR l.shipped IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN l.expected_total>l.shipped THEN l.expected_total-l.shipped ELSE 0 END AS outqty
 FROM upstream_raw_lines AS l INNER JOIN upstream_shipped_orders AS h ON l.warehouse_code=h.warehouse_code AND l.order_no=h.order_no LEFT JOIN upstream_monthly_materials AS a ON l.sku=a.sku WHERE l.completed_at>=CAST(:gea_p1 AS DATE) AND l.completed_at<CAST(:gea_p2 AS DATE)
 AND (:gea_p91 IS NULL OR l.warehouse_code=:gea_p91)), projected AS (SELECT t.belong_base AS base, t.pick_point_type2 AS pickup_type, t.pickup_point AS pickup_code, t.pickup_point_name AS pickup_name, t.cust_code AS customer, t.cust_name AS customer_name, t.new_material_code AS sku, t.new_material_name AS material_name, t.product_categ_name AS category, t.pinxiang AS item, t.xilie AS series, t.material_group_name AS material_group, t.region_name AS region, t.province_region_name AS province, t.sales_group_name AS sales_group, t.fromorderno AS from_order, t.executeorderno AS execute_order, t.fromorderno_month AS order_date, t.header_addtime AS created_at, t.complete_time AS completed_at, t.is_ontime AS is_ontime, CASE WHEN t.source_rows = 1 THEN t.order_qty_origin ELSE NULL END AS ordered, CASE WHEN t.source_rows = 1 THEN t.need_qty_origin ELSE NULL END AS demand, CASE WHEN t.source_rows = 1 THEN t.outqty ELSE NULL END AS shortage, CASE WHEN t.source_rows = 1 THEN t.qtyshipped ELSE NULL END AS shipped, CASE WHEN t.source_rows = 1 THEN CASE WHEN t.qtyshipped IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN t.qtyshipped >= 0 THEN t.order_qty_origin ELSE NULL END ELSE NULL END AS shipped_order_quantity, t.source_rows AS source_rows, CASE WHEN t.source_rows > 1 OR t.need_qty_origin IS NULL OR t.outqty IS NULL OR t.need_qty_origin < 0 OR t.outqty < 0 OR t.outqty > t.need_qty_origin THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS invalid, CASE WHEN t.source_rows = 1 THEN t.pack_unitqty ELSE NULL END AS source_occupied FROM source_records AS t), order_grouped AS (SELECT d.base AS base, d.pickup_type AS pickup_type, d.pickup_code AS pickup_code, d.pickup_name AS pickup_name, d.customer AS customer, d.customer_name AS customer_name, d.sku AS sku, d.material_name AS material_name, d.category AS category, d.item AS item, d.series AS series, d.material_group AS material_group, d.region AS region, d.province AS province, d.sales_group AS sales_group, d.from_order AS from_order, d.execute_order AS execute_order, d.order_date AS order_date, d.created_at AS created_at, d.completed_at AS completed_at, d.is_ontime AS is_ontime, CASE WHEN COUNT(d.ordered) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(d.ordered) ELSE NULL END AS ordered, CASE WHEN COUNT(d.demand) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(d.demand) ELSE NULL END AS demand, CASE WHEN COUNT(d.shortage) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(d.shortage) ELSE NULL END AS shortage, CASE WHEN COUNT(d.shipped) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(d.shipped) ELSE NULL END AS shipped, CASE WHEN COUNT(d.shipped_order_quantity) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(d.shipped_order_quantity) ELSE NULL END AS shipped_order_quantity, SUM(d.source_rows) AS source_rows, SUM(d.invalid) AS invalid, CASE WHEN COUNT(d.source_occupied) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(d.source_occupied) ELSE NULL END AS source_occupied FROM projected AS d GROUP BY d.base, d.pickup_type, d.pickup_code, d.pickup_name, d.customer, d.customer_name, d.sku, d.material_name, d.category, d.item, d.series, d.material_group, d.region, d.province, d.sales_group, d.from_order, d.execute_order, d.order_date, d.created_at, d.completed_at, d.is_ontime), business_rows AS (SELECT d.base AS base, d.pickup_type AS pickup_type, d.pickup_code AS AS shipped_order_quantity, r.source_rows AS source_rows, r.invalid AS invalid, r.business_day AS business_day, r.source_occupied AS source_occupied FROM business_rows AS r WHERE (:gea_p6 = FALSE OR AND (:gea_p14 = 'all' OR (:gea_p14 = 'equal' AND r.sku = :gea_p15) OR (:gea_p14 = 'missing' AND r.sku IS NULL)) AND (:gea_p16 = 'all' OR (:gea_p16 = 'equal' AND r.category = :gea_p17) OR (:gea_p16 = 'missing' AND r.category IS NULL)) AND (:gea_p18 = 'all' OR (:gea_p18 = 'equal' AND r.item = :gea_p19) OR (:gea_p18 = 'missing' AND r.item IS NULL)) AND (:gea_p20 = 'all' OR (:gea_p20 = 'equal' AND WITH upstream_snapshot AS (
 SELECT MAX(i.month_date) AS month_date FROM agents_scm_inventory_sku_data_d AS i
 WHERE i.warehouse_classify IN ('01','02','20')
), latest_inventory AS (SELECT s.month_date AS month_date FROM upstream_snapshot AS s),
upstream_warehouses AS (
 SELECT i.warehouseid AS warehouse_code, MAX(i.warehouse_name) AS warehouse_name
 FROM agents_scm_inventory_sku_data_d AS i INNER JOIN upstream_snapshot AS s ON i.month_date=s.month_date
 WHERE (i.warehouse_classify='20' OR i.warehouseid='N436')
 GROUP BY i.warehouseid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT i.warehouse_name)=1
), upstream_base_batches AS (
 SELECT i.belong_base AS base,i.material_code AS sku,i.warehouseid AS warehouse_code,
 i.prod_date AS prod_date,i.sap_warehouseid AS sap_warehouseid,i.plant AS plant,
 i.quality_batch AS quality_batch,i.is_good_prod AS is_good_prod,i.warehouse_classify AS warehouse_classify,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=1 AND COUNT(i.available_qty)=1 THEN SUM(i.available_qty) END AS available
 FROM agents_scm_inventory_sku_data_d AS i INNER JOIN upstream_snapshot AS s ON i.month_date=s.month_date
 WHERE i.warehouse_classify IN ('01','02') AND i.warehouseid<>'N436'
 GROUP BY i.belong_base,i.material_code,i.warehouseid,i.prod_date,i.sap_warehouseid,i.plant,i.quality_batch,i.is_good_prod,i.warehouse_classify
) , upstream_bases AS (
 SELECT b.base AS base FROM upstream_base_batches AS b GROUP BY b.base
), upstream_base_stock AS (
 SELECT b.base AS base,b.sku AS sku,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(b.available)=COUNT(*) THEN CASE WHEN SUM(b.available)>0 THEN SUM(b.available) ELSE 0 END END AS available
 FROM upstream_base_batches AS b GROUP BY b.base,b.sku
), upstream_base_warehouses AS (
 SELECT b.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code,CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT b.base)=1 THEN MAX(b.base) END AS base
 FROM upstream_base_batches AS b GROUP BY b.warehouse_code
), asn_lines AS (
 SELECT a.warehouseid AS warehouse_code,a.source_warehouseid AS source_wh,a.asnreference1 AS source_order,
 a.asnno AS asn_no,a.asnlineno AS line_no,a.material_code AS sku,
 MAX(a.warehouse_name) AS warehouse_name,MIN(a.header_addtime) AS created_at,
 MIN(a.actualarrivetime) AS requested_at,MAX(a.order_close_time) AS asn_closed_at,MAX(a.asnstatus) AS asn_status,
 MAX(a.lastreceivingtime) AS received_at,MAX(a.load_time) AS source_updated_at,COUNT(*) AS physical_rows,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=1 AND MIN(a.expectedqty)>=0 THEN MAX(a.expectedqty) END AS expected,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=1 AND MIN(a.receivedqty)>=0 THEN MAX(a.receivedqty) END AS received
 FROM agents_scm_asn_detail_d AS a
 WHERE (a.warehouse_classify='20' OR a.warehouseid='N436') AND a.asntype IN ('TT','COMPANY_SALE')
 AND a.asnstatus IN ('00','99') AND a.header_addtime<CAST(:gea_p2 AS DATE) AND (a.order_close_time>=CAST(:gea_p1 AS DATE) OR a.order_close_time IS NULL)
 GROUP BY a.warehouseid,a.source_warehouseid,a.asnreference1,a.asnno,a.asnlineno,a.material_code
), asn_orders AS (
 SELECT a.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code,a.source_wh AS source_wh,a.source_order AS source_order,a.sku AS sku,
 MAX(a.warehouse_name) AS warehouse_name,MIN(a.created_at) AS created_at,MIN(a.requested_at) AS requested_at,
 MAX(a.asn_closed_at) AS asn_closed_at,MAX(a.asn_status) AS asn_status,MAX(a.received_at) AS received_at,
 MAX(a.source_updated_at) AS source_updated_at,MIN(a.asn_no) AS fallback_no,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(a.expected)=COUNT(*) THEN SUM(a.expected) END AS expected,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(a.received)=COUNT(*) THEN SUM(a.received) END AS received,
 MAX(CASE WHEN a.physical_rows<>1 OR a.source_order IS NULL OR a.expected IS NULL OR a.received IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS invalid
 FROM asn_lines AS a GROUP BY a.warehouse_code,a.source_wh,a.source_order,a.sku
), asn_execution_keys AS (
 SELECT a.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code,a.source_wh AS source_wh,a.source_order AS source_order,a.sku AS sku
 FROM asn_orders AS a GROUP BY a.warehouse_code,a.source_wh,a.source_order,a.sku
), asn_execution_lines AS (
 SELECT k.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code,k.source_wh AS source_wh,k.source_order AS source_order,k.sku AS sku,
 e.executeorderno AS execute_order,e.executeorderlineno AS line_no,MAX(e.material_name) AS material_name,
 MAX(e.prapare_order_status) AS prepare_status,MAX(e.wms_close_time) AS shipped_at,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=1 AND MIN(e.qtyallocated)>=0 AND MIN(e.bizunitconvertrate)>0 THEN MAX(e.qtyallocated/e.bizunitconvertrate) END AS allocated,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=1 AND MIN(e.qtyshipped)>=0 AND MIN(e.bizunitconvertrate)>0 THEN MAX(e.qtyshipped/e.bizunitconvertrate) END AS shipped
 FROM asn_execution_keys AS k INNER JOIN agents_scm_execute_detail_hourly_d AS e
 ON e.fromorderno=k.source_order AND e.receive_wh=k.warehouse_code AND e.warehouseid=k.source_wh AND e.material_code=k.sku
 WHERE e.order_type='ZUB' AND e.detailstatus=10 AND NULLIF(TRIM(e.canceltime),'') IS NULL AND NULLIF(TRIM(e.dmscanceltime),'') IS NULL
 GROUP BY k.warehouse_code,k.source_wh,k.source_order,k.sku,e.executeorderno,e.executeorderlineno
), asn_execution AS (
 SELECT e.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code,e.source_wh AS source_wh,e.source_order AS source_order,e.sku AS sku,
 MAX(e.material_name) AS material_name,MAX(e.shipped_at) AS shipped_at,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT e.prepare_status)=1 THEN MAX(e.prepare_status) END AS prepare_status,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(e.allocated)=COUNT(*) THEN SUM(e.allocated) END AS allocated,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(e.shipped)=COUNT(*) THEN SUM(e.shipped) END AS shipped
 FROM asn_execution_lines AS e GROUP BY e.warehouse_code,e.source_wh,e.source_order,e.sku
), upstream_raw_lines AS (
 SELECT a.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code,a.warehouse_name AS warehouse_name,b.base AS base,
 COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(a.source_order),''),a.fallback_no) AS order_no,a.sku AS line_no,a.sku AS sku,
 e.material_name AS material_name,a.created_at AS created_at,a.requested_at AS requested_at,
 e.shipped_at AS completed_at,a.asn_closed_at AS closed_at,
 CASE WHEN a.asn_status='00' THEN '待收货' ELSE '已收货' END AS order_status,
 a.asn_status AS asn_status,e.prepare_status AS prepare_status,a.expected AS expected_total,a.received AS received_total,
 CASE WHEN e.allocated IS NOT NULL AND a.expected IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN e.allocated>a.expected THEN a.expected ELSE e.allocated END END AS allocated_total,
 a.source_updated_at AS source_updated_at,CASE WHEN a.invalid=0 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS source_rows,
 CASE WHEN a.expected IS NULL OR a.received IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN a.expected>a.received THEN a.expected-a.received ELSE 0 END AS ordered,
 CASE WHEN e.allocated IS NULL OR a.expected IS NULL OR a.received IS NULL THEN NULL
 WHEN e.allocated<=a.received THEN 0 WHEN e.allocated>=a.expected THEN CASE WHEN a.expected>a.received THEN a.expected-a.received ELSE 0 END ELSE e.allocated-a.received END AS allocated,
 CASE WHEN e.shipped IS NULL OR a.expected IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN e.shipped>a.expected THEN a.expected ELSE e.shipped END AS shipped
 FROM asn_orders AS a LEFT JOIN asn_execution AS e
 ON a.warehouse_code=e.warehouse_code AND a.source_wh=e.source_wh AND a.source_order=e.source_order AND a.sku=e.sku
 LEFT JOIN upstream_base_warehouses AS b ON a.source_wh=b.warehouse_code
 LEFT JOIN upstream_warehouses AS sender ON a.source_wh=sender.warehouse_code
 WHERE sender.warehouse_code IS NULL
), upstream_presence AS (
 SELECT COUNT(*) AS source_count FROM (SELECT 1 AS present FROM agents_scm_asn_detail_d AS a LIMIT 1) AS p
), upstream_monthly_materials AS (SELECT m.material_code AS sku,CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(m.product_categ_name),''))=1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(m.product_categ_name),'')) END AS category,CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(m.material_group_name),''))=1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(m.material_group_name),'')) END AS material_group FROM agents_scm_material_in_out_summary_d AS m GROUP BY m.material_code), upstream_shipped_orders AS (SELECT l.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code,l.order_no AS order_no FROM upstream_raw_lines AS l WHERE l.completed_at>=CAST(:gea_p1 AS DATE) AND l.completed_at<CAST(:gea_p2 AS DATE) GROUP BY l.warehouse_code,l.order_no HAVING SUM(l.shipped)>0 OR COUNT(l.shipped)<>COUNT(*)), source_records AS (SELECT l.order_no AS fromorderno,l.base AS belong_base,'分仓' AS pick_point_type2,
 l.warehouse_code AS pickup_point,l.warehouse_name AS pickup_point_name,l.base AS cust_code,l.base AS cust_name,
 l.sku AS new_material_code,l.material_name AS new_material_name,
 CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(255)) AS region_name,CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(255)) AS province_region_name,
 CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(255)) AS sales_group_name,CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(255)) AS xilie,CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(255)) AS pinxiang,
 a.material_group AS material_group_name,a.category AS product_categ_name,
 l.created_at AS fromorderno_month,l.created_at AS header_addtime,l.order_no AS executeorderno,
 l.completed_at AS complete_time,CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(255)) AS is_ontime,l.source_rows AS source_rows,
 l.expected_total AS order_qty_origin,l.expected_total AS need_qty_origin,l.allocated_total AS pack_unitqty,l.shipped AS qtyshipped,
 CASE WHEN l.expected_total IS NULL OR l.shipped IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN l.expected_total>l.shipped THEN l.expected_total-l.shipped ELSE 0 END AS outqty
 FROM upstream_raw_lines AS l INNER JOIN upstream_shipped_orders AS h ON l.warehouse_code=h.warehouse_code AND l.order_no=h.order_no LEFT JOIN upstream_monthly_materials AS a ON l.sku=a.sku WHERE l.completed_at>=CAST(:gea_p1 AS DATE) AND l.completed_at<CAST(:gea_p2 AS DATE)
 AND (:gea_p91 IS NULL OR l.warehouse_code=:gea_p91)), projected AS (SELECT t.belong_base AS base, t.pick_point_type2 AS pickup_type, t.pickup_point AS pickup_code, t.pickup_point_name AS pickup_name, t.cust_code AS customer, t.cust_name AS customer_name, t.new_material_code AS sku, t.new_material_name AS material_name, t.product_categ_name AS category, t.pinxiang AS item, t.xilie AS series, t.material_group_name AS material_group, t.region_name AS region, t.province_region_name AS province, t.sales_group_name AS sales_group, t.fromorderno AS from_order, t.executeorderno AS execute_order, t.fromorderno_month AS order_date, t.header_addtime AS created_at, t.complete_time AS completed_at, t.is_ontime AS is_ontime, CASE WHEN t.source_rows = 1 THEN t.order_qty_origin ELSE NULL END AS ordered, CASE WHEN t.source_rows = 1 THEN t.need_qty_origin ELSE NULL END AS demand, CASE WHEN t.source_rows = 1 THEN t.outqty ELSE NULL END AS shortage, CASE WHEN t.source_rows = 1 THEN t.qtyshipped ELSE NULL END AS shipped, CASE WHEN t.source_rows = 1 THEN CASE WHEN t.qtyshipped IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN t.qtyshipped >= 0 THEN t.order_qty_origin ELSE NULL END ELSE NULL END AS shipped_order_quantity, t.source_rows AS source_rows, CASE WHEN t.source_rows > 1 OR t.need_qty_origin IS NULL OR t.outqty IS NULL OR t.need_qty_origin < 0 OR t.outqty < 0 OR t.outqty > d.category AS category, d.item AS item, d.series AS series, d.material_group AS material_group, d.region AS region, d.province AS province, d.sales_group AS sales_group, d.from_order AS from_order, d.execute_order AS execute_order, d.order_date AS order_date, d.created_at AS created_at, d.completed_at AS completed_at, d.is_ontime AS is_ontime, CASE WHEN COUNT(d.ordered) = COUNT(*) THEN projected AS d GROUP BY d.base, d.pickup_type, d.pickup_code, d.pickup_name, d.customer, d.customer_name, d.sku, d.material_name, d.category, d.item, d.series, d.material_group, d.region, d.province,  CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=1 AND MIN(a.expectedqty)>=0 THEN MAX(a.expectedqty) END AS expected,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=1 AND MIN(a.receivedqty)>=0 THEN MAX(a.receivedqty) END AS received
 FROM agents_scm_asn_detail_d AS a
 WHERE (a.warehouse_classify='20' OR a.warehouseid='N436') AND a.asntype IN ('TT','COMPANY_SALE')
 AND a.asnstatus IN ('00','99') AND a.header_addtime<CAST(:gea_p2 AS DATE) AND (a.order_close_time>=CAST(:gea_p1 AS DATE) OR a.order_close_time IS NULL)
 GROUP BY a.warehouseid,a.source_warehouseid,a.asnreference1,a.asnno,a.asnlineno,a.material_code
), asn_orders AS (

 MAX(a.warehouse_name) AS warehouse_name,MIN(a.created_at) AS created_at,MIN(a.requested_at) AS requested_at,
 MAX(a.asn_closed_at) AS asn_closed_at,MAX(a.asn_status) AS asn_status,MAX(a.received_at) AS received_at,
 MAX(a.source_updated_at) AS source_updated_at,MIN(a.asn_no) AS fallback_no,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(a.expected)=COUNT(*) THEN SUM(a.expected) END AS expected,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(a.received)=COUNT(*) THEN SUM(a.received) END AS received,
 MAX(CASE WHEN a.physical_rows<>1 OR a.source_order IS NULL OR a.expected IS NULL OR a.received IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS invalid
 FROM asn_lines AS a GROUP BY a.warehouse_code,a.source_wh,a.source_order,a.sku
), asn_execution_keys AS (
 SELECT a.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code,a.source_wh AS source_wh,a.source_order AS source_order,a.sku AS sku
 FROM asn_orders AS a GROUP BY a.warehouse_code,a.source_wh,a.source_order,a.sku
), asn_execution_lines AS (
 SELECT k.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code,k.source_wh AS source_wh,k.source_order AS source_order,k.sku AS sku,
 e.executeorderno AS execute_order,e.executeorderlineno AS line_no,MAX(e.material_name) AS material_name,
 MAX(e.prapare_order_status) AS prepare_status,MAX(e.wms_close_time) AS shipped_at,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=1 AND MIN(e.qtyallocated)>=0 AND MIN(e.bizunitconvertrate)>0 THEN MAX(e.qtyallocated/e.bizunitconvertrate) END AS allocated,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=1 AND MIN(e.qtyshipped)>=0 AND MIN(e.bizunitconvertrate)>0 THEN MAX(e.qtyshipped/e.bizunitconvertrate) END AS shipped
 FROM asn_execution_keys AS k INNER JOIN agents_scm_execute_detail_hourly_d AS e
 ON e.fromorderno=k.source_order AND e.receive_wh=k.warehouse_code AND e.warehouseid=k.source_wh AND e.material_code=k.sku
 WHERE e.order_type='ZUB' AND e.detailstatus=10 AND NULLIF(TRIM(e.canceltime),'') IS NULL AND NULLIF(TRIM(e.dmscanceltime),'') IS NULL
 GROUP BY k.warehouse_code,k.source_wh,k.source_order,k.sku,e.executeorderno,e.executeorderlineno
), asn_execution AS (
 SELECT e.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code,e.source_wh AS source_wh,e.source_order AS source_order,e.sku AS sku,
 MAX(e.material_name) AS material_name,MAX(e.shipped_at) AS shipped_at,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT e.prepare_status)=1 THEN MAX(e.prepare_status) END AS prepare_status,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(e.allocated)=COUNT(*) THEN SUM(e.allocated) END AS allocated,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(e.shipped)=COUNT(*) THEN SUM(e.shipped) END AS shipped
 FROM asn_execution_lines AS e GROUP BY e.warehouse_code,e.source_wh,e.source_order,e.sku
), upstream_raw_lines AS (
 SELECT a.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code,a.warehouse_name AS warehouse_name,b.base AS base,
 COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(a.source_order),''),a.fallback_no) AS order_no,a.sku AS line_no,a.sku AS sku,
 e.material_name AS material_name,a.created_at AS created_at,a.requested_at AS requested_at,
 e.shipped_at AS completed_at,a.asn_closed_at AS closed_at,
 CASE WHEN a.asn_status='00' THEN '待收货' ELSE '已收货' END AS order_status,
 a.asn_status AS asn_status,e.prepare_status AS prepare_status,a.expected AS expected_total,a.received AS received_total,
 CASE WHEN e.allocated IS NOT NULL AND a.expected IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN e.allocated>a.expected THEN a.expected ELSE e.allocated END END AS allocated_total,
 a.source_updated_at AS source_updated_at,CASE WHEN a.invalid=0 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS source_rows,
 CASE WHEN a.expected IS NULL OR a.received IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN a.expected>a.received THEN a.expected-a.received ELSE 0 END AS ordered,
 CASE WHEN e.allocated IS NULL OR a.expected IS NULL OR a.received IS NULL THEN NULL
 WHEN e.allocated<=a.received THEN 0 WHEN e.allocated>=a.expected THEN CASE WHEN a.expected>a.received THEN a.expected-a.received ELSE 0 END ELSE e.allocated-a.received END AS allocated,
 CASE WHEN e.shipped IS NULL OR a.expected IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN e.shipped>a.expected THEN a.expected ELSE e.shipped END AS shipped
 FROM asn_orders AS a LEFT JOIN asn_execution AS e
 ON a.warehouse_code=e.warehouse_code AND a.source_wh=e.source_wh AND a.source_order=e.source_order AND a.sku=e.sku
 LEFT JOIN upstream_base_warehouses AS b ON a.source_wh=b.warehouse_code
 LEFT JOIN upstream_warehouses AS sender ON a.source_wh=sender.warehouse_code
 WHERE sender.warehouse_code IS NULL
), upstream_presence AS (
 SELECT COUNT(*) AS source_count FROM (SELECT 1 AS present FROM agents_scm_asn_detail_d AS a LIMIT 1) AS p
), upstream_monthly_materials AS (SELECT m.material_code AS sku,CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(m.product_categ_name),''))=1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(m.product_categ_name),'')) END AS category,CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(m.material_group_name),''))=1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(m.material_group_name),'')) END AS material_group FROM agents_scm_material_in_out_summary_d AS m GROUP BY m.material_code), upstream_shipped_orders AS (SELECT l.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code,l.order_no AS order_no FROM upstream_raw_lines AS l WHERE l.completed_at>=CAST(:gea_p1 AS DATE) AND l.completed_at<CAST(:gea_p2 AS DATE) GROUP BY l.warehouse_code,l.order_no HAVING SUM(l.shipped)>0 OR COUNT(l.shipped)<>COUNT(*)), source_records AS (SELECT l.order_no AS fromorderno,l.base AS belong_base,'分仓' AS pick_point_type2,
 l.warehouse_code AS pickup_point,l.warehouse_name AS pickup_point_name,l.base AS cust_code,l.base AS cust_name,
 l.sku AS new_material_code,l.material_name AS new_material_name,
 CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(255)) AS region_name,CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(255)) AS province_region_name,
 CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(255)) AS sales_group_name,CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(255)) AS xilie,CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(255)) AS pinxiang,
 a.material_group AS material_group_name,a.category AS product_categ_name,
 l.created_at AS fromorderno_month,l.created_at AS header_addtime,l.order_no AS executeorderno,
 l.completed_at AS complete_time,CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(255)) AS is_ontime,l.source_rows AS source_rows,
 l.expected_total AS order_qty_origin,l.expected_total AS need_qty_origin,l.allocated_total AS pack_unitqty,l.shipped AS qtyshipped,
 CASE WHEN l.expected_total IS NULL OR l.shipped IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN l.expected_total>l.shipped THEN l.expected_total-l.shipped ELSE 0 END AS outqty
 FROM upstream_raw_lines AS l INNER JOIN upstream_shipped_orders AS h ON l.warehouse_code=h.warehouse_code AND l.order_no=h.order_no LEFT JOIN upstream_monthly_materials AS a ON l.sku=a.sku WHERE l.completed_at>=CAST(:gea_p1 AS DATE) AND l.completed_at<CAST(:gea_p2 AS DATE)
 AND (:gea_p91 IS NULL OR l.warehouse_code=:gea_p91)), projected AS (SELECT t.belong_base AS base, t.pick_point_type2 AS pickup_type, t.pickup_point AS pickup_code, t.pickup_point_name AS pickup_name, t.cust_code AS customer, t.cust_name AS customer_name, t.new_material_code AS sku, t.new_material_name AS material_name, t.product_categ_name AS category, t.pinxiang AS item, t.xilie AS series, t.material_group_name AS material_group, t.region_name AS region, t.province_region_name AS province, t.sales_group_name AS sales_group, t.fromorderno AS from_order, t.executeorderno AS execute_order, t.fromorderno_month AS order_date, t.header_addtime AS created_at, t.complete_time AS completed_at, t.is_ontime AS is_ontime, CASE WHEN t.source_rows = 1 THEN t.order_qty_origin ELSE NULL END AS ordered, CASE WHEN t.source_rows = 1 THEN t.need_qty_origin ELSE NULL END AS demand, CASE WHEN t.source_rows = 1 THEN t.outqty ELSE NULL END AS shortage, CASE WHEN t.source_rows = 1 THEN t.qtyshipped ELSE NULL END AS shipped, CASE WHEN t.source_rows = 1 THEN CASE WHEN t.qtyshipped IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN t.qtyshipped >= 0 THEN t.order_qty_origin ELSE NULL END ELSE NULL END AS shipped_order_quantity, CASE WHEN t.source_rows > 1 OR t.need_qty_origin IS NULL OR t.outqty IS NULL OR t.need_qty_origin < 0 OR t.outqty < 0 OR t.outqty > t.need_qty_origin THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS invalid, CASE WHEN t.source_rows = 1 THEN t.pack_unitqty ELSE NULL END AS source_occupied FROM source_records AS t), order_grouped AS (SELECT d.base AS base, d.pickup_type AS pickup_type, d.pickup_code AS pickup_code, d.customer AS customer, d.customer_name AS customer_name, d.sku AS sku, d.material_name AS material_name, d.category AS category, d.item AS item, d.series AS series, d.region AS region, d.province AS province, d.sales_group AS sales_group, d.from_order AS from_order, CASE WHEN COUNT(d.ordered) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(d.ordered) ELSE NULL END AS ordered, CASE WHEN COUNT(d.demand) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(d.demand) ELSE NULL END AS demand, CASE WHEN COUNT(d.shortage) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(d.shortage) ELSE NULL END AS shortage, CASE WHEN COUNT(d.shipped) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(d.shipped) ELSE NULL END AS shipped, CASE WHEN COUNT(d.shipped_order_quantity) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(d.shipped_order_quantity) ELSE NULL END AS shipped_order_quantity, SUM(d.invalid) AS invalid, CASE WHEN COUNT(d.source_occupied) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(d.source_occupied) ELSE NULL END AS source_occupied FROM projected AS d GROUP BY d.base, d.pickup_type, d.pickup_code, d.pickup_name, d.customer, d.customer_name, d.sku, d.material_name, d.category, d.item, d.series, d.material_group, d.region, d.province, d.sales_group, d.from_order, d.execute_order, d.order_date, d.created_at, d.completed_at, d.is_ontime), business_rows AS (SELECT d.base AS base, d.pickup_type AS pickup_type, d.pickup_code AS pickup_code, d.customer AS customer, d.customer_name AS customer_name, d.sku AS sku, d.material_name AS material_name, d.category AS category, d.item AS item, d.series AS series, d.region AS region, d.province AS province, d.sales_group AS sales_group, d.from_order AS from_order, d.ordered AS ordered, d.demand AS demand, d.shortage AS shortage, d.shipped AS shipped, d.shipped_order_quantity AS shipped_order_quantity, d.invalid AS invalid, d.source_occupied AS source_occupied FROM order_grouped AS d), filtered AS (SELECT r.sku AS sku, r.from_order AS from_order, r.ordered AS ordered, r.demand AS demand, r.shortage AS shortage, r.shipped AS shipped, r.shipped_order_quantity AS shipped_order_quantity, r.invalid AS invalid, r.source_occupied AS source_occupied FROM business_rows AS r WHERE (:gea_p6 = FALSE OR r.base IN (:gea_p7)) AND (:gea_p8 = 'all' OR (:gea_p8 = 'equal' AND r.pickup_type = :gea_p9) OR (:gea_p8 = 'missing' AND r.pickup_type IS NULL)) AND (:gea_p10 = 'all' OR (:gea_p10 = 'equal' AND r.pickup_code = :gea_p11) OR (:gea_p10 = 'missing' AND r.pickup_code IS NULL)) AND (:gea_p12 = 'all' OR (:gea_p12 = 'equal' AND r.customer = :gea_p13) OR (:gea_p12 = 'missing' AND r.customer IS NULL)) AND (:gea_p14 = 'all' OR (:gea_p14 = 'equal' AND r.sku = :gea_p15) OR (:gea_p14 = 'missing' AND r.sku IS NULL)) AND (:gea_p16 = 'all' OR (:gea_p16 = 'equal' AND r.category = :gea_p17) OR (:gea_p16 = 'missing' AND r.category IS NULL)) AND (:gea_p18 = 'all' OR (:gea_p18 = 'equal' AND r.item = :gea_p19) OR (:gea_p18 = 'missing' AND r.item IS NULL)) AND (:gea_p20 = 'all' OR (:gea_p20 = 'equal' AND r.series = :gea_p21) OR (:gea_p20 = 'missing' AND r.series IS NULL)) AND (:gea_p22 = 'all' OR (:gea_p22 = 'equal' AND r.region = :gea_p23) OR (:gea_p22 = 'missing' AND r.region IS NULL)) AND (:gea_p24 = 'all' OR (:gea_p24 = 'equal' AND r.province = :gea_p25) OR (:gea_p24 = 'missing' AND r.province IS NULL)) AND (:gea_p26 = 'all' OR (:gea_p26 = 'equal' AND r.sales_group = :gea_p27) OR (:gea_p26 = 'missing' AND r.sales_group IS NULL)) AND (:gea_p28 IS NULL OR LOWER(r.sku) LIKE LOWER(:gea_p28) OR LOWER(r.material_name) LIKE LOWER(:gea_p28) OR LOWER(r.from_order) LIKE LOWER(:gea_p28) OR LOWER(r.customer_name) LIKE LOWER(:gea_p28)) AND (:gea_p29 IS NULL OR r.category <> :gea_p29)) SELECT COUNT(*) AS row_count, CASE WHEN COUNT(r.ordered) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(r.ordered) ELSE NULL END AS ordered, CASE WHEN COUNT(r.demand) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(r.demand) ELSE NULL END AS demand, CASE WHEN COUNT(r.shortage) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(r.shortage) ELSE NULL END AS shortage, CASE WHEN COUNT(r.shipped) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(r.shipped) ELSE NULL END AS shipped, CASE WHEN COUNT(r.shipped_order_quantity) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(r.shipped_order_quantity) ELSE NULL END AS shipped_order_quantity, SUM(CASE WHEN r.ordered IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS missing_ordered, SUM(CASE WHEN r.demand IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS missing_demand, COUNT(*) - COUNT(r.shortage) AS missing_shortage, SUM(CASE WHEN r.shipped IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS missing_shipped, SUM(CASE WHEN r.shipped_order_quantity IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS missing_shipped_order_quantity, COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(r.from_order), '')) AS from_order_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.shortage > 0 THEN NULLIF(TRIM(r.from_order), '') ELSE NULL END) AS affected_from_order_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(r.from_order), '') IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS missing_order_identity, SUM(r.invalid) AS invalid, CASE WHEN SUM(r.invalid) = 0 AND SUM(r.demand) > 0 THEN 1 - SUM(r.shortage) / SUM(r.demand) ELSE NULL END AS fulfillment_rate, CASE WHEN COUNT(r.source_occupied) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(r.source_occupied) ELSE NULL END AS source_occupied, COUNT(*) - COUNT(r.source_occupied) AS missing_source_occupied, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 0 WHEN SUM(r.invalid) = 0 AND COUNT(*) = COUNT(r.shortage) AND MIN(r.shortage) >= 0 AND SUM(CASE WHEN r.shortage > 0 AND NULLIF(TRIM(r.sku), '') IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0 THEN COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.shortage > 0 THEN NULLIF(TRIM(r.sku), '') ELSE NULL END) ELSE NULL END AS shortage_sku_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN r.shortage > 0 AND NULLIF(TRIM(r.sku), '') IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS missing_shortage_sku_identity FROM filtered AS r

orders.groups.title: 订单业务期事实分层汇总分页
orders.groups.notes: 分仓向基地下单以ASN调拨入库为主体，warehouseid为收货分仓，source_warehouseid关联基地；状态00为未收货、90排除、99完成。按CRM源单号、来源仓、收货分仓和SKU关联基地出库单，出库占用按业务单位转换率换为件；ASN预期及实收原值为件。当前订单为ASN未收货量，基地占用扣除已收货并受当前需求上限约束。缺货按订单剩余需求、基地与SKU共享可用库存计算，按订单创建时间/执行单号/分仓编码稳定先后分配；分仓、SKU、搜索及分页在分配后筛选。缺失或冲突保持未知。

orders.groups_count.title: 订单业务期事实分层分组总数
orders.groups_count.notes: 分仓向基地下单以ASN调拨入库为主体，warehouseid为收货分仓，source_warehouseid关联基地；状态00为未收货、90排除、99完成。按CRM源单号、来源仓、收货分仓和SKU关联基地出库单，出库占用按业务单位转换率换为件；ASN预期及实收原值为件。当前订单为ASN未收货量，基地占用扣除已收货并受当前需求上限约束。缺货按订单剩余需求、基地与SKU共享可用库存计算，按订单创建时间/执行单号/分仓编码稳定先后分配；分仓、SKU、搜索及分页在分配后筛选。缺失或冲突保持未知。

WITH upstream_snapshot AS (
 SELECT MAX(i.month_date) AS month_date FROM agents_scm_inventory_sku_data_d AS i
 WHERE i.warehouse_classify IN ('01','02','20')
), latest_inventory AS (SELECT s.month_date AS month_date FROM upstream_snapshot AS s),
upstream_warehouses AS (
 SELECT i.warehouseid AS warehouse_code, MAX(i.warehouse_name) AS warehouse_name
 FROM agents_scm_inventory_sku_data_d AS i INNER JOIN upstream_snapshot AS s ON i.month_date=s.month_date
 WHERE (i.warehouse_classify='20' OR i.warehouseid='N436')
 GROUP BY i.warehouseid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT i.warehouse_name)=1
), upstream_base_batches AS (
 SELECT i.belong_base AS base,i.material_code AS sku,i.warehouseid AS warehouse_code,
 i.prod_date AS prod_date,i.sap_warehouseid AS sap_warehouseid,i.plant AS plant,
 i.quality_batch AS quality_batch,i.is_good_prod AS is_good_prod,i.warehouse_classify AS warehouse_classify,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=1 AND COUNT(i.available_qty)=1 THEN SUM(i.available_qty) END AS available
 FROM agents_scm_inventory_sku_data_d AS i INNER JOIN upstream_snapshot AS s ON i.month_date=s.month_date
 WHERE i.warehouse_classify IN ('01','02') AND i.warehouseid<>'N436'
 GROUP BY i.belong_base,i.material_code,i.warehouseid,i.prod_date,i.sap_warehouseid,i.plant,i.quality_batch,i.is_good_prod,i.warehouse_classify
) , upstream_bases AS (
 SELECT b.base AS base FROM upstream_base_batches AS b GROUP BY b.base
), upstream_base_stock AS (
 SELECT b.base AS base,b.sku AS sku,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(b.available)=COUNT(*) THEN CASE WHEN SUM(b.available)>0 THEN SUM(b.available) ELSE 0 END END AS available
 FROM upstream_base_batches AS b GROUP BY b.base,b.sku
), upstream_base_warehouses AS (
 SELECT b.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code,CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT b.base)=1 THEN MAX(b.base) END AS base
 FROM upstream_base_batches AS b GROUP BY b.warehouse_code
), asn_lines AS (
 SELECT a.warehouseid AS warehouse_code,a.source_warehouseid AS source_wh,a.asnreference1 AS source_order,
 a.asnno AS asn_no,a.asnlineno AS line_no,a.material_code AS sku,
 MAX(a.warehouse_name) AS warehouse_name,MIN(a.header_addtime) AS created_at,
 MIN(a.actualarrivetime) AS requested_at,MAX(a.order_close_time) AS asn_closed_at,MAX(a.asnstatus) AS asn_status,
 MAX(a.lastreceivingtime) AS received_at,MAX(a.load_time) AS source_updated_at,COUNT(*) AS physical_rows,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=1 AND MIN(a.expectedqty)>=0 THEN MAX(a.expectedqty) END AS expected,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=1 AND MIN(a.receivedqty)>=0 THEN MAX(a.receivedqty) END AS received
 FROM agents_scm_asn_detail_d AS a
 WHERE (a.warehouse_classify='20' OR a.warehouseid='N436') AND a.asntype IN ('TT','COMPANY_SALE')
 AND a.asnstatus IN ('00','99') AND a.header_addtime<CAST(:gea_p2 AS DATE) AND (a.order_close_time>=CAST(:gea_p1 AS DATE) OR a.order_close_time IS NULL)
 GROUP BY a.warehouseid,a.source_warehouseid,a.asnreference1,a.asnno,a.asnlineno,a.material_code
), asn_orders AS (
 SELECT a.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code,a.source_wh AS source_wh,a.source_order AS source_order,a.sku AS sku,

 MAX(a.asn_closed_at) AS asn_closed_at,MAX(a.asn_status) AS asn_status,MAX(a.received_at) AS received_at,
 MAX(a.source_updated_at) AS source_updated_at,MIN(a.asn_no) AS fallback_no,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(a.expected)=COUNT(*) THEN SUM(a.expected) END AS expected,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(a.received)=COUNT(*) THEN SUM(a.received) END AS received,

 FROM asn_lines AS a GROUP BY a.warehouse_code,a.source_wh,a.source_order,a.sku
), asn_execution_keys AS (
 SELECT a.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code,a.source_wh AS source_wh,a.source_order AS source_order,a.sku AS sku
 FROM asn_orders AS a GROUP BY a.warehouse_code,a.source_wh,a.source_order,a.sku
), asn_execution_lines AS (
 SELECT k.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code,k.source_wh AS source_wh,k.source_order AS source_order,k.sku AS sku,
 e.executeorderno AS execute_order,e.executeorderlineno AS line_no,MAX(e.material_name) AS material_name,

 CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=1 AND MIN(e.qtyallocated)>=0 AND MIN(e.bizunitconvertrate)>0 THEN MAX(e.qtyallocated/e.bizunitconvertrate) END AS allocated,

 CASE WHEN e.allocated IS NOT NULL AND a.expected IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN e.allocated>a.expected THEN a.expected ELSE e.allocated END END AS allocated_total,
 a.source_updated_at AS source_updated_at,CASE WHEN a.invalid=0 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS source_rows,
 CASE WHEN a.expected IS NULL OR a.received IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN a.expected>a.received THEN a.expected-a.received ELSE 0 END AS ordered,
 CASE WHEN e.allocated IS NULL OR a.expected IS NULL OR a.received IS NULL THEN NULL
 WHEN e.allocated<=a.received THEN 0 WHEN e.allocated>=a.expected THEN CASE WHEN a.expected>a.received THEN a.expected-a.received ELSE 0 END ELSE e.allocated-a.received END AS allocated,
 CASE WHEN e.shipped IS NULL OR a.expected IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN e.shipped>a.expected THEN a.expected ELSE e.shipped END AS shipped
 FROM asn_orders AS a LEFT JOIN asn_execution AS e
 ON a.warehouse_code=e.warehouse_code AND a.source_wh=e.source_wh AND a.source_order=e.source_order AND a.sku=e.sku

 LEFT JOIN upstream_warehouses AS sender ON a.source_wh=sender.warehouse_code
 WHERE sender.warehouse_code IS NULL
), upstream_presence AS (
 SELECT COUNT(*) AS source_count FROM (SELECT 1 AS present FROM agents_scm_asn_detail_d AS a LIMIT 1) AS p

orders.options.title: 订单业务期事实级联筛选选项
orders.options.notes: 分仓向基地下单以ASN调拨入库为主体，warehouseid为收货分仓，source_warehouseid关联基地；状态00为未收货、90排除、99完成。按CRM源单号、来源仓、收货分仓和SKU关联基地出库单，出库占用按业务单位转换率换为件；ASN预期及实收原值为件。当前订单为ASN未收货量，基地占用扣除已收货并受当前需求上限约束。缺货按订单剩余需求、基地与SKU共享可用库存计算，按订单创建时间/执行单号/分仓编码稳定先后分配；分仓、SKU、搜索及分页在分配后筛选。缺失或冲突保持未知。

WITH upstream_snapshot AS (

 WHERE (i.warehouse_classify='20' OR i.warehouseid='N436')
 GROUP BY i.warehouseid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT i.warehouse_name)=1
), upstream_base_batches AS (
 SELECT i.belong_base AS base,i.material_code AS sku,i.warehouseid AS warehouse_code,

 CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=1 AND COUNT(i.available_qty)=1 THEN SUM(i.available_qty) END AS available
 FROM agents_scm_inventory_sku_data_d AS i INNER JOIN upstream_snapshot AS s ON i.month_date=s.month_date
 WHERE i.warehouse_classify IN ('01','02') AND i.warehouseid<>'N436'

orders.options_count.title: 订单业务期事实筛选选项数
orders.options_count.notes: 分仓向基地下单以ASN调拨入库为主体，warehouseid为收货分仓，source_warehouseid关联基地；状态00为未收货、90排除、99完成。按CRM源单号、来源仓、收货分仓和SKU关联基地出库单，出库占用按业务单位转换率换为件；ASN预期及实收原值为件。当前订单为ASN未收货量，基地占用扣除已收货并受当前需求上限约束。缺货按订单剩余需求、基地与SKU共享可用库存计算，按订单创建时间/执行单号/分仓编码稳定先后分配；分仓、SKU、搜索及分页在分配后筛选。缺失或冲突保持未知。

WITH upstream_snapshot AS (
 SELECT MAX(i.month_date) AS month_date FROM agents_scm_inventory_sku_data_d AS i
 WHERE i.warehouse_classify IN ('01','02','20')
), latest_inventory AS (SELECT s.month_date AS month_date FROM upstream_snapshot AS s),
upstream_warehouses AS (
 SELECT i.warehouseid AS warehouse_code, MAX(i.warehouse_name) AS warehouse_name
 FROM agents_scm_inventory_sku_data_d AS i INNER JOIN upstream_snapshot AS s ON i.month_date=s.month_date
 WHERE (i.warehouse_classify='20' OR i.warehouseid='N436')
 GROUP BY i.warehouseid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT i.warehouse_name)=1
), upstream_base_batches AS (
 SELECT i.belong_base AS base,i.material_code AS sku,i.warehouseid AS warehouse_code,
 i.prod_date AS prod_date,i.sap_warehouseid AS sap_warehouseid,i.plant AS plant,
 i.quality_batch AS quality_batch,i.is_good_prod AS is_good_prod,i.warehouse_classify AS warehouse_classify,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=1 AND COUNT(i.available_qty)=1 THEN SUM(i.available_qty) END AS available
 FROM agents_scm_inventory_sku_data_d AS i INNER JOIN upstream_snapshot AS s ON i.month_date=s.month_date
 WHERE i.warehouse_classify IN ('01','02') AND i.warehouseid<>'N436'
 GROUP BY i.belong_base,i.material_code,i.warehouseid,i.prod_date,i.sap_warehouseid,i.plant,i.quality_batch,i.is_good_prod,i.warehouse_classify
) , upstream_bases AS (
 SELECT b.base AS base FROM upstream_base_batches AS b GROUP BY b.base
), upstream_base_stock AS (
 SELECT b.base AS base,b.sku AS sku,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(b.available)=COUNT(*) THEN CASE WHEN SUM(b.available)>0 THEN SUM(b.available) ELSE 0 END END AS available
 FROM upstream_base_batches AS b GROUP BY b.base,b.sku
), upstream_base_warehouses AS (
 SELECT b.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code,CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT b.base)=1 THEN MAX(b.base) END AS base
 FROM upstream_base_batches AS b GROUP BY b.warehouse_code
), asn_lines AS (
 SELECT a.warehouseid AS warehouse_code,a.source_warehouseid AS source_wh,a.asnreference1 AS source_order,
 a.asnno AS asn_no,a.asnlineno AS line_no,a.material_code AS sku,
 MAX(a.warehouse_name) AS warehouse_name,MIN(a.header_addtime) AS created_at,
 MIN(a.actualarrivetime) AS requested_at,MAX(a.order_close_time) AS asn_closed_at,MAX(a.asnstatus) AS asn_status,
 MAX(a.lastreceivingtime) AS received_at,MAX(a.load_time) AS source_updated_at,COUNT(*) AS physical_rows,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=1 AND MIN(a.expectedqty)>=0 THEN MAX(a.expectedqty) END AS expected,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=1 AND MIN(a.receivedqty)>=0 THEN MAX(a.receivedqty) END AS received
 FROM agents_scm_asn_detail_d AS a
 WHERE (a.warehouse_classify='20' OR a.warehouseid='N436') AND a.asntype IN ('TT','COMPANY_SALE')
 AND a.asnstatus IN ('00','99') AND a.header_addtime<CAST(:gea_p2 AS DATE) AND (a.order_close_time>=CAST(:gea_p1 AS DATE) OR a.order_close_time IS NULL)
 GROUP BY a.warehouseid,a.source_warehouseid,a.asnreference1,a.asnno,a.asnlineno,a.material_code
), asn_orders AS (
 SELECT a.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code,a.source_wh AS source_wh,a.source_order AS source_order,a.sku AS sku,
 MAX(a.warehouse_name) AS warehouse_name,MIN(a.created_at) AS created_at,MIN(a.requested_at) AS requested_at,
 MAX(a.asn_closed_at) AS asn_closed_at,MAX(a.asn_status) AS asn_status,MAX(a.received_at) AS received_at,
 MAX(a.source_updated_at) AS source_updated_at,MIN(a.asn_no) AS fallback_no,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(a.expected)=COUNT(*) THEN SUM(a.expected) END AS expected,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(a.received)=COUNT(*) THEN SUM(a.received) END AS received,
 MAX(CASE WHEN a.physical_rows<>1 OR a.source_order IS NULL OR a.expected IS NULL OR a.received IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS invalid
 FROM asn_lines AS a GROUP BY a.warehouse_code,a.source_wh,a.source_order,a.sku
), asn_execution_keys AS (
 SELECT a.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code,a.source_wh AS source_wh,a.source_order AS source_order,a.sku AS sku
 FROM asn_orders AS a GROUP BY a.warehouse_code,a.source_wh,a.source_order,a.sku
), asn_execution_lines AS (
 SELECT k.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code,k.source_wh AS source_wh,k.source_order AS source_order,k.sku AS sku,
 e.executeorderno AS execute_order,e.executeorderlineno AS line_no,MAX(e.material_name) AS material_name,
 MAX(e.prapare_order_status) AS prepare_status,MAX(e.wms_close_time) AS shipped_at,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=1 AND MIN(e.qtyallocated)>=0 AND MIN(e.bizunitconvertrate)>0 THEN MAX(e.qtyallocated/e.bizunitconvertrate) END AS allocated,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=1 AND MIN(e.qtyshipped)>=0 AND MIN(e.bizunitconvertrate)>0 THEN MAX(e.qtyshipped/e.bizunitconvertrate) END AS shipped
 FROM asn_execution_keys AS k INNER JOIN agents_scm_execute_detail_hourly_d AS e
 ON e.fromorderno=k.source_order AND e.receive_wh=k.warehouse_code AND e.warehouseid=k.source_wh AND e.material_code=k.sku
 WHERE e.order_type='ZUB' AND e.detailstatus=10 AND NULLIF(TRIM(e.canceltime),'') IS NULL AND NULLIF(TRIM(e.dmscanceltime),'') IS NULL
 GROUP BY k.warehouse_code,k.source_wh,k.source_order,k.sku,e.executeorderno,e.executeorderlineno
), asn_execution AS (
 SELECT e.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code,e.source_wh AS source_wh,e.source_order AS source_order,e.sku AS sku,
 MAX(e.material_name) AS material_name,MAX(e.shipped_at) AS shipped_at,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT e.prepare_status)=1 THEN MAX(e.prepare_status) END AS prepare_status,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(e.allocated)=COUNT(*) THEN SUM(e.allocated) END AS allocated,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(e.shipped)=COUNT(*) THEN SUM(e.shipped) END AS shipped
 FROM asn_execution_lines AS e GROUP BY e.warehouse_code,e.source_wh,e.source_order,e.sku
), upstream_raw_lines AS (
 SELECT a.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code,a.warehouse_name AS warehouse_name,b.base AS base,
 COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(a.source_order),''),a.fallback_no) AS order_no,a.sku AS line_no,a.sku AS sku,
 e.material_name AS material_name,a.created_at AS created_at,a.requested_at AS requested_at,
 e.shipped_at AS completed_at,a.asn_closed_at AS closed_at,
 CASE WHEN a.asn_status='00' THEN '待收货' ELSE '已收货' END AS order_status,
 a.asn_status AS asn_status,e.prepare_status AS prepare_status,a.expected AS expected_total,a.received AS received_total,
 CASE WHEN e.allocated IS NOT NULL AND a.expected IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN e.allocated>a.expected THEN a.expected ELSE e.allocated END END AS allocated_total,
 a.source_updated_at AS source_updated_at,CASE WHEN a.invalid=0 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS source_rows,
 CASE WHEN a.expected IS NULL OR a.received IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN a.expected>a.received THEN a.expected-a.received ELSE 0 END AS ordered,
 CASE WHEN e.allocated IS NULL OR a.expected IS NULL OR a.received IS NULL THEN NULL
 WHEN e.allocated<=a.received THEN 0 WHEN e.allocated>=a.expected THEN CASE WHEN a.expected>a.received THEN a.expected-a.received ELSE 0 END ELSE e.allocated-a.received END AS allocated,
 CASE WHEN e.shipped IS NULL OR a.expected IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN e.shipped>a.expected THEN a.expected ELSE e.shipped END AS shipped
 FROM asn_orders AS a LEFT JOIN asn_execution AS e
 ON a.warehouse_code=e.warehouse_code AND a.source_wh=e.source_wh AND a.source_order=e.source_order AND a.sku=e.sku

 LEFT JOIN upstream_warehouses AS sender ON a.source_wh=sender.warehouse_code

health.detail.notes: 按统计日、仓库编码、SKU读取；相同重复值只取一次，冲突保持未知。age_days是最大库龄。名称优先取库存快照商品名，源缺值时沿用原唯一SKU字典补充。名称均为当前参考，不回溯历史命名；左连接不改变库存行数。；商品资料仅按唯一SKU匹配产品清单补空名称/物料组；同SKU字段冲突保留空，数量与日期范围不变。 批次现库存按仓库/SKU求和；不按 warehouse_classify 过滤或归类；分仓用 warehouseid 编码关联和筛选、warehouse_name 展示名称；基地用 belong_base 名称关联和筛选；商品名称取 material_name；基地与分仓为同一事实集的维度，不重复相加；正库存且生产日期有效的批次计算最大货龄。按原分仓规则逐批次汇总60天及以上超龄库存、90天及以上滞库库存；非正库存或无有效货龄的批次数量不计入风险量。安全/目标库存及更新时间仍保持未知。

health.count.title: 源库存健康度筛选后总数
health.count.notes: 按统计日/基地/仓库类型/仓库编码/SKU读取；同键重复保留NULL。total_qty用于仓库库存范围；current_stock、target_stock_qty为跨仓重复的基地SKU参考值，不逐仓相加。货龄采用同记录total_qty加权，不推演批次。 批次现库存按仓库/SKU求和；不按 warehouse_classify 过滤或归类；分仓用 warehouseid 编码关联和筛选、warehouse_name 展示名称；基地用 belong_base 名称关联和筛选；商品名称取 material_name；基地与分仓为同一事实集的维度，不重复相加；正库存且生产日期有效的批次计算最大货龄。按原分仓规则逐批次汇总60天及以上超龄库存、90天及以上滞库库存；非正库存或无有效货龄的批次数量不计入风险量。安全/目标库存及更新时间仍保持未知。

health.summary.title: 源库存健康度全范围汇总
health.summary.notes: 按统计日/基地/仓库类型/仓库编码/SKU读取；同键重复保留NULL。total_qty用于仓库库存范围；current_stock、target_stock_qty为跨仓重复的基地SKU参考值，不逐仓相加。货龄采用同记录total_qty加权，不推演批次。 批次现库存按仓库/SKU求和；不按 warehouse_classify 过滤或归类；分仓用 warehouseid 编码关联和筛选、warehouse_name 展示名称；基地用 belong_base 名称关联和筛选；商品名称取 material_name；基地与分仓为同一事实集的维度，不重复相加；正库存且生产日期有效的批次计算最大货龄。按原分仓规则逐批次汇总60天及以上超龄库存、90天及以上滞库库存；非正库存或无有效货龄的批次数量不计入风险量。安全/目标库存及更新时间仍保持未知。

health.groups.notes: 按统计日/基地/仓库类型/仓库编码/SKU读取；同键重复保留NULL。total_qty用于仓库库存范围；current_stock、target_stock_qty为跨仓重复的基地SKU参考值，不逐仓相加。货龄采用同记录total_qty加权，不推演批次。 批次现库存按仓库/SKU求和；不按 warehouse_classify 过滤或归类；分仓用 warehouseid 编码关联和筛选、warehouse_name 展示名称；基地用 belong_base 名称关联和筛选；商品名称取 material_name；基地与分仓为同一事实集的维度，不重复相加；正库存且生产日期有效的批次计算最大货龄。按原分仓规则逐批次汇总60天及以上超龄库存、90天及以上滞库库存；非正库存或无有效货龄的批次数量不计入风险量。安全/目标库存及更新时间仍保持未知。

WITH inventory_batch_dates AS (
SELECT b.warehouseid AS warehouseid, b.material_code AS material_code,
 b.month_date AS month_date,
 b.warehouse_name AS warehouse_name, b.belong_base AS belong_base, b.material_name AS material_name,
 b.live_qty AS live_qty, b.available_qty AS available_qty,
 b.pack_unit_qty AS pack_unit_qty, b.freeze_qty AS freeze_qty,

 CAST(SUBSTRING(b.month_date, 5, 2) AS INTEGER) AS snapshot_month,
 CAST(SUBSTRING(b.month_date, 7, 2) AS INTEGER) AS snapshot_day,
 CASE WHEN LENGTH(b.prod_date) >= 10 AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 5, 1) = '-' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 8, 1) = '-' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 1, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 2, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 3, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 4, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 6, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 7, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 9, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 10, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' THEN CAST(SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) ELSE NULL END AS production_year,
 CASE WHEN LENGTH(b.prod_date) >= 10 AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 5, 1) = '-' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 8, 1) = '-' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 1, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 2, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 3, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 4, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 6, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 7, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 9, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 10, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' THEN CAST(SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 6, 2) AS INTEGER) ELSE NULL END AS production_month,
 CASE WHEN LENGTH(b.prod_date) >= 10 AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 5, 1) = '-' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 8, 1) = '-' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 1, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 2, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 3, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 4, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 6, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 7, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 9, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 10, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' THEN CAST(SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 9, 2) AS INTEGER) ELSE NULL END AS production_day

WHERE (b.warehouse_classify = '20' OR b.warehouseid = 'N436') AND b.month_date = REPLACE(CAST(:gea_p1 AS VARCHAR(10)), '-', '')

health.options_count.title: 源库存健康度筛选选项数
health.options_count.notes: 按统计日/基地/仓库类型/仓库编码/SKU读取；同键重复保留NULL。total_qty用于仓库库存范围；current_stock、target_stock_qty为跨仓重复的基地SKU参考值，不逐仓相加。货龄采用同记录total_qty加权，不推演批次。 批次现库存按仓库/SKU求和；不按 warehouse_classify 过滤或归类；分仓用 warehouseid 编码关联和筛选、warehouse_name 展示名称；基地用 belong_base 名称关联和筛选；商品名称取 material_name；基地与分仓为同一事实集的维度，不重复相加；正库存且生产日期有效的批次计算最大货龄。按原分仓规则逐批次汇总60天及以上超龄库存、90天及以上滞库库存；非正库存或无有效货龄的批次数量不计入风险量。安全/目标库存及更新时间仍保持未知。
