health.detail.atomic.title: 源库存健康度明细分页
health.detail.atomic.notes: 同一SQL读取总数及当前页；空页用一条标记行保留总数；外层显式保持原排序，不下载全量明细。；商品资料仅按唯一SKU匹配产品清单补空名称/物料组；同SKU字段冲突保留空，数量与日期范围不变。 批次现库存按仓库/SKU求和；不按 warehouse_classify 过滤或归类；分仓用 warehouseid 编码关联和筛选、warehouse_name 展示名称；基地用 belong_base 名称关联和筛选；商品名称取 material_name；基地与分仓为同一事实集的维度，不重复相加；正库存且生产日期有效的批次计算最大货龄。按原分仓规则逐批次汇总60天及以上超龄库存、90天及以上滞库库存；非正库存或无有效货龄的批次数量不计入风险量。安全/目标库存及更新时间仍保持未知。

 CASE WHEN LENGTH(b.prod_date) >= 10 AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 5, 1) = '-' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 8, 1) = '-' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 1, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 2, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 3, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 4, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 6, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 7, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 9, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 10, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' THEN CAST(SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 6, 2) AS INTEGER) ELSE NULL END AS production_month,
 CASE WHEN LENGTH(b.prod_date) >= 10 AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 5, 1) = '-' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 8, 1) = '-' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 1, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 2, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 3, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 4, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 6, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 7, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 9, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 10, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' THEN CAST(SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 9, 2) AS INTEGER) ELSE NULL END AS production_day

inventory.detail.atomic.title: 库存与目标明细分页
inventory.detail.atomic.notes: 同一SQL读取总数及当前页；空页用一条标记行保留总数；外层显式保持原排序，不下载全量明细。；商品资料仅按唯一SKU匹配产品清单补空名称/物料组；同SKU字段冲突保留空，数量与日期范围不变。 D96业务确认：既有唯一版本聚合后的目标为空且同范围日均需求非负时，按日均需求×9派生展示目标；真实0不替换，日均需求缺失或重复版本保持未知；不回写上游。 D101：唯一基地/月/版本/SKU日均为空时，按同版本销售计划+调拨出库计划×0.5除该计划月自然天数补齐；缺任一要素或重复则保留未知；有效0保留。 D101/D114：同一基地与月份整体选版，纠偏→月初、月初→滚动；已选版本缺SKU、NULL、0或重复均不借用另一版本字段。

orders.detail.atomic.notes: 分仓向基地下单以ASN调拨入库为主体，warehouseid为收货分仓，source_warehouseid关联基地；状态00为未收货、90排除、99完成。按CRM源单号、来源仓、收货分仓和SKU关联基地出库单，出库占用按业务单位转换率换为件；ASN预期及实收原值为件。当前订单为ASN未收货量，基地占用扣除已收货并受当前需求上限约束。缺货按订单剩余需求、基地与SKU共享可用库存计算，按订单创建时间/执行单号/分仓编码稳定先后分配；分仓、SKU、搜索及分页在分配后筛选。缺失或冲突保持未知。

request.sql:
SELECT p.base AS base, p.pickup_type AS pickup_type, p.pickup_code AS pickup_code, p.pickup_name AS pickup_name, p.customer AS customer, p.customer_name AS customer_name, p.sku AS sku, p.material_name AS material_name, p.category AS category, p.item AS item, p.series AS series, p.material_group AS material_group, p.region AS region, p.province AS province, p.sales_group AS sales_group, p.from_order AS from_order, p.execute_order AS execute_order, p.order_date AS order_date, p.created_at AS created_at, p.completed_at AS completed_at, p.is_ontime AS is_ontime, p.ordered AS ordered, p.demand AS demand, p.shortage AS shortage, p.shipped AS shipped, p.shipped_order_quantity AS shipped_order_quantity, p.source_rows AS source_rows, p.invalid AS invalid, p.business_day AS business_day, p.source_occupied AS source_occupied, c.total AS page_scope_total, p.page_row_present AS page_row_present FROM (WITH upstream_snapshot AS (
 SELECT MAX(i.month_date) AS month_date FROM agents_scm_inventory_sku_data_d AS i
 WHERE i.warehouse_classify IN ('01','02','20')
), latest_inventory AS (SELECT s.month_date AS month_date FROM upstream_snapshot AS s),
upstream_warehouses AS (
 SELECT i.warehouseid AS warehouse_code, MAX(i.warehouse_name) AS warehouse_name
 FROM agents_scm_inventory_sku_data_d AS i INNER JOIN upstream_snapshot AS s ON i.month_date=s.month_date
 WHERE (i.warehouse_classify='20' OR i.warehouseid='N436')
 GROUP BY i.warehouseid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT i.warehouse_name)=1
), upstream_base_batches AS (
 SELECT i.belong_base AS base,i.material_code AS sku,i.warehouseid AS warehouse_code,
 i.prod_date AS prod_date,i.sap_warehouseid AS sap_warehouseid,i.plant AS plant,
 i.quality_batch AS quality_batch,i.is_good_prod AS is_good_prod,i.warehouse_classify AS warehouse_classify,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=1 AND COUNT(i.available_qty)=1 THEN SUM(i.available_qty) END AS available
 FROM agents_scm_inventory_sku_data_d AS i INNER JOIN upstream_snapshot AS s ON i.month_date=s.month_date
 WHERE i.warehouse_classify IN ('01','02') AND i.warehouseid<>'N436'
 GROUP BY i.belong_base,i.material_code,i.warehouseid,i.prod_date,i.sap_warehouseid,i.plant,i.quality_batch,i.is_good_prod,i.warehouse_classify
) , upstream_bases AS (
 SELECT b.base AS base FROM upstream_base_batches AS b GROUP BY b.base
), upstream_base_stock AS (
 SELECT b.base AS base,b.sku AS sku,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(b.available)=COUNT(*) THEN CASE WHEN SUM(b.available)>0 THEN SUM(b.available) ELSE 0 END END AS available
 FROM upstream_base_batches AS b GROUP BY b.base,b.sku
), upstream_base_warehouses AS (
 SELECT b.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code,CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT b.base)=1 THEN MAX(b.base) END AS base
 FROM upstream_base_batches AS b GROUP BY b.warehouse_code
), asn_lines AS (
 SELECT a.warehouseid AS warehouse_code,a.source_warehouseid AS source_wh,a.asnreference1 AS source_order,
 a.asnno AS asn_no,a.asnlineno AS line_no,a.material_code AS sku,
 MAX(a.warehouse_name) AS warehouse_name,MIN(a.header_addtime) AS created_at,
 MIN(a.actualarrivetime) AS requested_at,MAX(a.order_close_time) AS asn_closed_at,MAX(a.asnstatus) AS asn_status,
 MAX(a.lastreceivingtime) AS received_at,MAX(a.load_time) AS source_updated_at,COUNT(*) AS physical_rows,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=1 AND MIN(a.expectedqty)>=0 THEN MAX(a.expectedqty) END AS expected,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=1 AND MIN(a.receivedqty)>=0 THEN MAX(a.receivedqty) END AS received
 FROM agents_scm_asn_detail_d AS a
 WHERE (a.warehouse_classify='20' OR a.warehouseid='N436') AND a.asntype IN ('TT','COMPANY_SALE')
 AND a.asnstatus IN ('00','99') AND a.header_addtime<CAST(:gea_p2 AS DATE) AND (a.order_close_time>=CAST(:gea_p1 AS DATE) OR a.order_close_time IS NULL)
 GROUP BY a.warehouseid,a.source_warehouseid,a.asnreference1,a.asnno,a.asnlineno,a.material_code
), asn_orders AS (
 SELECT a.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code,a.source_wh AS source_wh,a.source_order AS source_order,a.sku AS sku,
 MAX(a.warehouse_name) AS warehouse_name,MIN(a.created_at) AS created_at,MIN(a.requested_at) AS requested_at,
 MAX(a.asn_closed_at) AS asn_closed_at,MAX(a.asn_status) AS asn_status,MAX(a.received_at) AS received_at,
 MAX(a.source_updated_at) AS source_updated_at,MIN(a.asn_no) AS fallback_no,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(a.expected)=COUNT(*) THEN SUM(a.expected) END AS expected,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(a.received)=COUNT(*) THEN SUM(a.received) END AS received,
 MAX(CASE WHEN a.physical_rows<>1 OR a.source_order IS NULL OR a.expected IS NULL OR a.received IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS invalid
 FROM asn_lines AS a GROUP BY a.warehouse_code,a.source_wh,a.source_order,a.sku
), asn_execution_keys AS (
 SELECT a.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code,a.source_wh AS source_wh,a.source_order AS source_order,a.sku AS sku
 FROM asn_orders AS a GROUP BY a.warehouse_code,a.source_wh,a.source_order,a.sku
), asn_execution_lines AS (
 SELECT k.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code,k.source_wh AS source_wh,k.source_order AS source_order,k.sku AS sku,
 e.executeorderno AS execute_order,e.executeorderlineno AS line_no,MAX(e.material_name) AS material_name,
 MAX(e.prapare_order_status) AS prepare_status,MAX(e.wms_close_time) AS shipped_at,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=1 AND MIN(e.qtyallocated)>=0 AND MIN(e.bizunitconvertrate)>0 THEN MAX(e.qtyallocated/e.bizunitconvertrate) END AS allocated,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=1 AND MIN(e.qtyshipped)>=0 AND MIN(e.bizunitconvertrate)>0 THEN MAX(e.qtyshipped/e.bizunitconvertrate) END AS shipped
 FROM asn_execution_keys AS k INNER JOIN agents_scm_execute_detail_hourly_d AS e
 ON e.fromorderno=k.source_order AND e.receive_wh=k.warehouse_code AND e.warehouseid=k.source_wh AND e.material_code=k.sku
 WHERE e.order_type='ZUB' AND e.detailstatus=10 AND NULLIF(TRIM(e.canceltime),'') IS NULL AND NULLIF(TRIM(e.dmscanceltime),'') IS NULL
 GROUP BY k.warehouse_code,k.source_wh,k.source_order,k.sku,e.executeorderno,e.executeorderlineno
), asn_execution AS (
 SELECT e.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code,e.source_wh AS source_wh,e.source_order AS source_order,e.sku AS sku,
 MAX(e.material_name) AS material_name,MAX(e.shipped_at) AS shipped_at,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT e.prepare_status)=1 THEN MAX(e.prepare_status) END AS prepare_status,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(e.allocated)=COUNT(*) THEN SUM(e.allocated) END AS allocated,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(e.shipped)=COUNT(*) THEN SUM(e.shipped) END AS shipped
 FROM asn_execution_lines AS e GROUP BY e.warehouse_code,e.source_wh,e.source_order,e.sku
), upstream_raw_lines AS (
 SELECT a.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code,a.warehouse_name AS warehouse_name,b.base AS base,
 COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(a.source_order),''),a.fallback_no) AS order_no,a.sku AS line_no,a.sku AS sku,
 e.material_name AS material_name,a.created_at AS created_at,a.requested_at AS requested_at,
 e.shipped_at AS completed_at,a.asn_closed_at AS closed_at,
 CASE WHEN a.asn_status='00' THEN '待收货' ELSE '已收货' END AS order_status,
 a.asn_status AS asn_status,e.prepare_status AS prepare_status,a.expected AS expected_total,a.received AS received_total,
 CASE WHEN e.allocated IS NOT NULL AND a.expected IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN e.allocated>a.expected THEN a.expected ELSE e.allocated END END AS allocated_total,
 a.source_updated_at AS source_updated_at,CASE WHEN a.invalid=0 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS source_rows,
 CASE WHEN a.expected IS NULL OR a.received IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN a.expected>a.received THEN a.expected-a.received ELSE 0 END AS ordered,
 CASE WHEN e.allocated IS NULL OR a.expected IS NULL OR a.received IS NULL THEN NULL
 WHEN e.allocated<=a.received THEN 0 WHEN e.allocated>=a.expected THEN CASE WHEN a.expected>a.received THEN a.expected-a.received ELSE 0 END ELSE e.allocated-a.received END AS allocated,
 CASE WHEN e.shipped IS NULL OR a.expected IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN e.shipped>a.expected THEN a.expected ELSE e.shipped END AS shipped
 FROM asn_orders AS a LEFT JOIN asn_execution AS e
 ON a.warehouse_code=e.warehouse_code AND a.source_wh=e.source_wh AND a.source_order=e.source_order AND a.sku=e.sku
 LEFT JOIN upstream_base_warehouses AS b ON a.source_wh=b.warehouse_code
 LEFT JOIN upstream_warehouses AS sender ON a.source_wh=sender.warehouse_code
 WHERE sender.warehouse_code IS NULL
), upstream_presence AS (
 SELECT COUNT(*) AS source_count FROM (SELECT 1 AS present FROM agents_scm_asn_detail_d AS a LIMIT 1) AS p
), upstream_monthly_materials AS (SELECT m.material_code AS sku,CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(m.product_categ_name),''))=1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(m.product_categ_name),'')) END AS category,CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(m.material_group_name),''))=1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(m.material_group_name),'')) END AS material_group FROM agents_scm_material_in_out_summary_d AS m GROUP BY m.material_code), upstream_shipped_orders AS (SELECT l.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code,l.order_no AS order_no FROM upstream_raw_lines AS l WHERE l.completed_at>=CAST(:gea_p1 AS DATE) AND l.completed_at<CAST(:gea_p2 AS DATE) GROUP BY l.warehouse_code,l.order_no HAVING SUM(l.shipped)>0 OR COUNT(l.shipped)<>COUNT(*)), source_records AS (SELECT l.order_no AS fromorderno,l.base AS belong_base,'分仓' AS pick_point_type2,
 l.warehouse_code AS pickup_point,l.warehouse_name AS pickup_point_name,l.base AS cust_code,l.base AS cust_name,

t.material_group_name AS material_group, t.region_name AS region, t.province_region_name AS province, t.sales_group_name AS sales_group, t.fromorderno AS from_order, t.executeorderno AS execute_order, t.fromorderno_month AS order_date, t.header_addtime AS created_at, t.complete_time AS completed_at, t.is_ontime AS is_ontime, CASE WHEN t.source_rows = 1 THEN t.order_qty_origin ELSE NULL END AS ordered, CASE WHEN t.source_rows = 1 THEN t.need_qty_origin ELSE NULL END AS demand, CASE WHEN t.source_rows = 1 THEN t.outqty ELSE NULL END AS shortage, CASE WHEN t.source_rows = 1 THEN t.qtyshipped ELSE NULL END AS shipped, CASE WHEN t.source_rows = 1 THEN CASE WHEN t.qtyshipped IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN t.qtyshipped >= 0 THEN t.order_qty_origin ELSE NULL END ELSE NULL END AS shipped_order_quantity, t.source_rows AS source_rows, CASE WHEN t.source_rows > 1 OR t.need_qty_origin IS NULL OR t.outqty IS NULL OR t.need_qty_origin < 0 OR t.outqty < 0 OR t.outqty > t.need_qty_origin THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS invalid, CASE WHEN t.source_rows = 1 THEN t.pack_unitqty ELSE NULL END AS source_occupied FROM source_records AS t), order_grouped AS (SELECT d.base AS base, shipped_order_quantity, SUM(d.source_rows) AS source_rows, SUM(d.invalid) AS invalid, CASE WHEN COUNT(d.source_occupied) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(d.source_occupied) ELSE NULL END AS source_occupied FROM projected AS d GROUP BY d.base, d.pickup_type, d.pickup_code, d.pickup_name, d.customer, d.customer_name, d.sku, d.material_name, d.category, d.item, d.series, d.material_group, d.region, d.province, base_shipments.detail.title: 基地实际发货
base_shipments.detail.notes: 以工厂发货来源plant_flag=工厂为范围，按实际发货日期汇总；正向量、负向量（负数量绝对值）和净量分列。保留未知基地组，不把分仓再次计入工厂发货。无本期记录保持空，不用30日日均乘30；数量先在SQL按基地SKU汇总。此来源为发货，不代表完整出库或库存周转。

replenishment.count.title: 分仓补货完整范围计数
replenishment.count.notes: 分仓向基地下单以ASN调拨入库为主体，warehouseid为收货分仓，source_warehouseid关联基地；状态00为未收货、90排除、99完成。按CRM源单号、来源仓、收货分仓和SKU关联基地出库单，出库占用按业务单位转换率换为件；ASN预期及实收原值为件。当前订单为ASN未收货量，基地占用扣除已收货并受当前需求上限约束。缺货按订单剩余需求、基地与SKU共享可用库存计算，按订单创建时间/执行单号/分仓编码稳定先后分配；分仓、SKU、搜索及分页在分配后筛选。缺失或冲突保持未知。 D97：有业务包含当前及次月已发布调拨计划的正值活动；仅判定是否发生业务，不借此换算或填充计划数量；同仓SKU同月重复保持未知。

/* fc-list-interactions:v1 */ WITH quick_transfer_plans AS (SELECT p.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code, p.material_code AS sku, CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=1 THEN MAX(CASE WHEN p.warehouse_month_transfer_plan>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) ELSE NULL END AS has_business FROM agents_scm_warehouse_transfer_plan_data_d AS p WHERE p.stat_month IN (:gea_p3952) GROUP BY p.warehouse_code,p.material_code,p.stat_month), quick_transfer_activity AS (SELECT q.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code,q.sku AS sku,MAX(q.has_business) AS has_business FROM quick_transfer_plans AS q GROUP BY q.warehouse_code,q.sku), list_source AS (WITH fc_branch_scope AS (SELECT b.warehouseid AS warehouse_code FROM agents_scm_inventory_sku_data_d AS b WHERE (:gea_p1 <> 'equal' OR b.warehouseid = :gea_p2) AND (b.warehouse_classify = '20' OR b.warehouseid = 'N436') AND b.month_date = REPLACE(CAST(:gea_p2200 AS VARCHAR(10)), '-', '') AND NOT NULLIF(TRIM(b.warehouseid), '') IS NULL GROUP BY b.warehouseid), upstream_snapshot AS (
 SELECT MAX(i.month_date) AS month_date FROM agents_scm_inventory_sku_data_d AS i
 WHERE i.warehouse_classify IN ('01','02','20')
), latest_inventory AS (SELECT s.month_date AS month_date FROM upstream_snapshot AS s),
upstream_warehouses AS (
 SELECT i.warehouseid AS warehouse_code, MAX(i.warehouse_name) AS warehouse_name
 FROM agents_scm_inventory_sku_data_d AS i INNER JOIN upstream_snapshot AS s ON i.month_date=s.month_date
 WHERE (i.warehouse_classify='20' OR i.warehouseid='N436')
 GROUP BY i.warehouseid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT i.warehouse_name)=1
), upstream_base_batches AS (
 SELECT i.belong_base AS base,i.material_code AS sku,i.warehouseid AS warehouse_code,
 i.prod_date AS prod_date,i.sap_warehouseid AS sap_warehouseid,i.plant AS plant,
 i.quality_batch AS quality_batch,i.is_good_prod AS is_good_prod,i.warehouse_classify AS warehouse_classify,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=1 AND COUNT(i.available_qty)=1 THEN SUM(i.available_qty) END AS available
 FROM agents_scm_inventory_sku_data_d AS i INNER JOIN upstream_snapshot AS s ON i.month_date=s.month_date
 WHERE i.warehouse_classify IN ('01','02') AND i.warehouseid<>'N436'
 GROUP BY i.belong_base,i.material_code,i.warehouseid,i.prod_date,i.sap_warehouseid,i.plant,i.quality_batch,i.is_good_prod,i.warehouse_classify
) , upstream_bases AS (
 SELECT b.base AS base FROM upstream_base_batches AS b GROUP BY b.base
), upstream_base_stock AS (
 SELECT b.base AS base,b.sku AS sku,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(b.available)=COUNT(*) THEN CASE WHEN SUM(b.available)>0 THEN SUM(b.available) ELSE 0 END END AS available
 FROM upstream_base_batches AS b GROUP BY b.base,b.sku
), upstream_base_warehouses AS (
 SELECT b.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code,CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT b.base)=1 THEN MAX(b.base) END AS base
 FROM upstream_base_batches AS b GROUP BY b.warehouse_code
), asn_lines AS (
 SELECT a.warehouseid AS warehouse_code,a.source_warehouseid AS source_wh,a.asnreference1 AS source_order,
 a.asnno AS asn_no,a.asnlineno AS line_no,a.material_code AS sku,
 MAX(a.warehouse_name) AS warehouse_name,MIN(a.header_addtime) AS created_at,
 MIN(a.actualarrivetime) AS requested_at,MAX(a.order_close_time) AS asn_closed_at,MAX(a.asnstatus) AS asn_status,
 MAX(a.lastreceivingtime) AS received_at,MAX(a.load_time) AS source_updated_at,COUNT(*) AS physical_rows,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=1 AND MIN(a.expectedqty)>=0 THEN MAX(a.expectedqty) END AS expected,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=1 AND MIN(a.receivedqty)>=0 THEN MAX(a.receivedqty) END AS received
 FROM agents_scm_asn_detail_d AS a
 WHERE (a.warehouse_classify='20' OR a.warehouseid='N436') AND a.asntype IN ('TT','COMPANY_SALE')
 AND a.asnstatus = '00' AND a.order_close_time IS NULL
 GROUP BY a.warehouseid,a.source_warehouseid,a.asnreference1,a.asnno,a.asnlineno,a.material_code
), asn_orders AS (
 SELECT a.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code,a.source_wh AS source_wh,a.source_order AS source_order,a.sku AS sku,
 MAX(a.warehouse_name) AS warehouse_name,MIN(a.created_at) AS created_at,MIN(a.requested_at) AS requested_at,
 MAX(a.asn_closed_at) AS asn_closed_at,MAX(a.asn_status) AS asn_status,MAX(a.received_at) AS received_at,
 MAX(a.source_updated_at) AS source_updated_at,MIN(a.asn_no) AS fallback_no,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(a.expected)=COUNT(*) THEN SUM(a.expected) END AS expected,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(a.received)=COUNT(*) THEN SUM(a.received) END AS received,
 MAX(CASE WHEN a.physical_rows<>1 OR a.source_order IS NULL OR a.expected IS NULL OR a.received IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS invalid
 FROM asn_lines AS a GROUP BY a.warehouse_code,a.source_wh,a.source_order,a.sku
), asn_execution_keys AS (
 SELECT a.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code,a.source_wh AS source_wh,a.source_order AS source_order,a.sku AS sku
 FROM asn_orders AS a GROUP BY a.warehouse_code,a.source_wh,a.source_order,a.sku
), asn_execution_lines AS (
 SELECT k.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code,k.source_wh AS source_wh,k.source_order AS source_order,k.sku AS sku,
 e.executeorderno AS execute_order,e.executeorderlineno AS line_no,MAX(e.material_name) AS material_name,
 MAX(e.prapare_order_status) AS prepare_status,MAX(e.wms_close_time) AS shipped_at,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=1 AND MIN(e.qtyallocated)>=0 AND MIN(e.bizunitconvertrate)>0 THEN MAX(e.qtyallocated/e.bizunitconvertrate) END AS allocated,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=1 AND MIN(e.qtyshipped)>=0 AND MIN(e.bizunitconvertrate)>0 THEN MAX(e.qtyshipped/e.bizunitconvertrate) END AS shipped
 FROM asn_execution_keys AS k INNER JOIN agents_scm_execute_detail_hourly_d AS e
 ON e.fromorderno=k.source_order AND e.receive_wh=k.warehouse_code AND e.warehouseid=k.source_wh AND e.material_code=k.sku
 WHERE e.order_type='ZUB' AND e.detailstatus=10 AND NULLIF(TRIM(e.canceltime),'') IS NULL AND NULLIF(TRIM(e.dmscanceltime),'') IS NULL
 GROUP BY k.warehouse_code,k.source_wh,k.source_order,k.sku,e.executeorderno,e.executeorderlineno
), asn_execution AS (
 SELECT e.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code,e.source_wh AS source_wh,e.source_order AS source_order,e.sku AS sku,
 MAX(e.material_name) AS material_name,MAX(e.shipped_at) AS shipped_at,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT e.prepare_status)=1 THEN MAX(e.prepare_status) END AS prepare_status,

COALESCE(co.allocated_qty, 0) END AS current_order_allocated, CASE WHEN op.source_order_count = 0 OR co.invalid_sku <> 0 THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE(co.remaining_qty, 0) END AS current_order_remaining, CASE WHEN op.source_order_count = 0 OR co.invalid_sku <> 0 THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE(co.shortage_qty, 0) END AS current_order_shortage, CASE WHEN r.available_qty IS NULL OR pp.current_transfer IS NULL OR pp.current_out IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE r.available_qty + pp.current_transfer - pp.current_out END AS expected_month_end_qty, CASE WHEN pp.current_count <> 1 OR pp.current_out IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN pp.current_out - r.month_ship_positive > 0 THEN pp.current_out - r.month_ship_positive ELSE 0 END AS period_remaining_out, CASE WHEN pp.current_count = 1 AND pp.current_out >= 0 THEN CEIL(pp.current_out / CAST(:gea_p2301 AS DECIMAL(20, 6))) ELSE NULL END AS period_current_daily, CASE WHEN pp.next_count = 1 AND pp.next_out >= 0 THEN CEIL(pp.next_out / CAST(:gea_p2702 AS DECIMAL(20, 6))) ELSE NULL END AS period_next_daily, r.calculation_order_remaining AS calculation_order_remaining FROM filtered AS r LEFT JOIN fc_period_plans AS pp ON pp.warehouse_code = r.warehouse_code AND pp.sku = r.sku LEFT JOIN fc_current_orders AS co ON co.location_type = '分仓' AND co.warehouseid = r.warehouse_code AND co.material_code = r.sku CROSS JOIN fc_order_presence AS op), list_filtered AS (SELECT r.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code, r.sku AS sku, r.warehouse_name AS warehouse_name, r.material_name AS material_name, r.category AS category, r.material_group AS material_group, r.inventory_qty AS inventory_qty, r.available_qty AS available_qty, r.occupied_qty AS occupied_qty, r.frozen_qty AS frozen_qty, r.max_age AS max_age, r.stock_date AS stock_date, r.stock_present AS stock_present, r.plan_present AS plan_present, r.source_rows AS source_rows, r.preparing_present AS preparing_present, r.in_transit_present AS in_transit_present, r.daily_plan AS daily_plan, r.last_month_actual_qty AS last_month_actual_qty, r.current_day_avg_qty AS current_day_avg_qty, r.month_out_plan AS month_out_plan, r.future30_qty AS future30_qty, r.open_transfer_reported_qty AS open_transfer_reported_qty, r.in_transit AS in_transit, r.preparing AS preparing, r.stat_month AS stat_month, r.plan_source AS plan_source, r.warehouse_month_transfer_plan AS warehouse_month_transfer_plan, r.month_ship_positive AS month_ship_positive, r.month_ship_net AS month_ship_net, r.rolling_ship_positive AS rolling_ship_positive, r.rolling_ship_daily AS rolling_ship_daily, r.last_ship_date AS last_ship_date, r.ship_source_rows AS ship_source_rows, r.plan_calculable AS plan_calculable, r.cycle_days AS cycle_days, r.calculation_status AS calculation_status, r.target_inventory_qty AS target_inventory_qty, r.recommended_qty AS recommended_qty, r.urgent AS urgent, r.historical_turnover_days AS historical_turnover_days, r.planned_daily_shipment AS planned_daily_shipment, r.remaining_outbound_qty AS remaining_outbound_qty, r.calculation_daily AS calculation_daily, r.forecast_turnover_days AS forecast_turnover_days, r.target_gap_qty AS target_gap_qty, r.safety_days AS safety_days, r.period_current_out AS period_current_out, r.period_current_transfer AS period_current_transfer, r.period_next_out AS period_next_out, r.period_next_transfer AS period_next_transfer, r.period_current_source AS period_current_source, r.period_next_source AS period_next_source, r.period_plan_status AS period_plan_status, r.current_order_demand AS current_order_demand, r.current_order_allocated AS current_order_allocated, r.current_order_remaining AS current_order_remaining, r.current_order_shortage AS current_order_shortage, r.expected_month_end_qty AS expected_month_end_qty, r.period_remaining_out AS period_remaining_out, r.period_current_daily AS period_current_daily, r.period_next_daily AS period_next_daily, r.calculation_order_remaining AS calculation_order_remaining FROM list_source AS r WHERE (NOT :gea_p7 IS NULL OR :gea_p4100 = 'all' OR (:gea_p4100 = 'business' AND (r.inventory_qty > 0 OR r.preparing > 0 OR r.rolling_ship_daily > 0 OR r.period_current_out > 0 OR r.period_current_transfer > 0 OR r.period_next_out > 0 OR r.period_next_transfer > 0)) OR (:gea_p4100 = 'urgent' AND r.current_order_shortage > 0) OR (:gea_p4100 = 'recommended' AND r.recommended_qty > 0))) SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM list_filtered AS r

replenishment.summary.title: 分仓补货完整范围汇总
replenishment.summary.notes: 分仓向基地下单以ASN调拨入库为主体，warehouseid为收货分仓，source_warehouseid关联基地；状态00为未收货、90排除、99完成。按CRM源单号、来源仓、收货分仓和SKU关联基地出库单，出库占用按业务单位转换率换为件；ASN预期及实收原值为件。当前订单为ASN未收货量，基地占用扣除已收货并受当前需求上限约束。缺货按订单剩余需求、基地与SKU共享可用库存计算，按订单创建时间/执行单号/分仓编码稳定先后分配；分仓、SKU、搜索及分页在分配后筛选。缺失或冲突保持未知。 D97：有业务包含当前及次月已发布调拨计划的正值活动；仅判定是否发生业务，不借此换算或填充计划数量；同仓SKU同月重复保持未知。

/* fc-warehouse-exceptions:N436 */ WITH quick_transfer_plans AS (SELECT p.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code, p.material_code AS sku, CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=1 THEN MAX(CASE WHEN p.warehouse_month_transfer_plan>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) ELSE NULL END AS has_business FROM agents_scm_warehouse_transfer_plan_data_d AS p WHERE p.stat_month IN (:gea_p3952) GROUP BY p.warehouse_code,p.material_code,p.stat_month), quick_transfer_activity AS (SELECT q.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code,q.sku AS sku,MAX(q.has_business) AS has_business FROM quick_transfer_plans AS q GROUP BY q.warehouse_code,q.sku), fc_branch_scope AS (SELECT b.warehouseid AS warehouse_code FROM agents_scm_inventory_sku_data_d AS b WHERE (:gea_p1 <> 'equal' OR b.warehouseid = :gea_p2) AND (b.warehouse_classify = '20' OR b.warehouseid = 'N436') AND b.month_date = REPLACE(CAST(:gea_p2200 AS VARCHAR(10)), '-', '') AND NOT NULLIF(TRIM(b.warehouseid), '') IS NULL GROUP BY b.warehouseid), upstream_snapshot AS (
 SELECT MAX(i.month_date) AS month_date FROM agents_scm_inventory_sku_data_d AS i
 WHERE i.warehouse_classify IN ('01','02','20')
), latest_inventory AS (SELECT s.month_date AS month_date FROM upstream_snapshot AS s),
upstream_warehouses AS (
 SELECT i.warehouseid AS warehouse_code, MAX(i.warehouse_name) AS warehouse_name
 FROM agents_scm_inventory_sku_data_d AS i INNER JOIN upstream_snapshot AS s ON i.month_date=s.month_date
 WHERE (i.warehouse_classify='20' OR i.warehouseid='N436')
 GROUP BY i.warehouseid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT i.warehouse_name)=1
), upstream_base_batches AS (
 SELECT i.belong_base AS base,i.material_code AS sku,i.warehouseid AS warehouse_code,
 i.prod_date AS prod_date,i.sap_warehouseid AS sap_warehouseid,i.plant AS plant,
 i.quality_batch AS quality_batch,i.is_good_prod AS is_good_prod,i.warehouse_classify AS warehouse_classify,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=1 AND COUNT(i.available_qty)=1 THEN SUM(i.available_qty) END AS available
 FROM agents_scm_inventory_sku_data_d AS i INNER JOIN upstream_snapshot AS s ON i.month_date=s.month_date
 WHERE i.warehouse_classify IN ('01','02') AND i.warehouseid<>'N436'
 GROUP BY i.belong_base,i.material_code,i.warehouseid,i.prod_date,i.sap_warehouseid,i.plant,i.quality_batch,i.is_good_prod,i.warehouse_classify
) , upstream_bases AS (
 SELECT b.base AS base FROM upstream_base_batches AS b GROUP BY b.base
), upstream_base_stock AS (
 SELECT b.base AS base,b.sku AS sku,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(b.available)=COUNT(*) THEN CASE WHEN SUM(b.available)>0 THEN SUM(b.available) ELSE 0 END END AS available
 FROM upstream_base_batches AS b GROUP BY b.base,b.sku
), upstream_base_warehouses AS (
 SELECT b.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code,CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT b.base)=1 THEN MAX(b.base) END AS base
 FROM upstream_base_batches AS b GROUP BY b.warehouse_code
), asn_lines AS (
 SELECT a.warehouseid AS warehouse_code,a.source_warehouseid AS source_wh,a.asnreference1 AS source_order,
 a.asnno AS asn_no,a.asnlineno AS line_no,a.material_code AS sku,
 MAX(a.warehouse_name) AS warehouse_name,MIN(a.header_addtime) AS created_at,
 MIN(a.actualarrivetime) AS requested_at,MAX(a.order_close_time) AS asn_closed_at,MAX(a.asnstatus) AS asn_status,
 MAX(a.lastreceivingtime) AS received_at,MAX(a.load_time) AS source_updated_at,COUNT(*) AS physical_rows,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=1 AND MIN(a.expectedqty)>=0 THEN MAX(a.expectedqty) END AS expected,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=1 AND MIN(a.receivedqty)>=0 THEN MAX(a.receivedqty) END AS received
 FROM agents_scm_asn_detail_d AS a
 WHERE (a.warehouse_classify='20' OR a.warehouseid='N436') AND a.asntype IN ('TT','COMPANY_SALE')
 AND a.asnstatus = '00' AND a.order_close_time IS NULL
 GROUP BY a.warehouseid,a.source_warehouseid,a.asnreference1,a.asnno,a.asnlineno,a.material_code
), asn_orders AS (
 SELECT a.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code,a.source_wh AS source_wh,a.source_order AS source_order,a.sku AS sku,
 MAX(a.warehouse_name) AS warehouse_name,MIN(a.created_at) AS created_at,MIN(a.requested_at) AS requested_at,
 MAX(a.asn_closed_at) AS asn_closed_at,MAX(a.asn_status) AS asn_status,MAX(a.received_at) AS received_at,
 MAX(a.source_updated_at) AS source_updated_at,MIN(a.asn_no) AS fallback_no,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(a.expected)=COUNT(*) THEN SUM(a.expected) END AS expected,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(a.received)=COUNT(*) THEN SUM(a.received) END AS received,
 MAX(CASE WHEN a.physical_rows<>1 OR a.source_order IS NULL OR a.expected IS NULL OR a.received IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS invalid
 FROM asn_lines AS a GROUP BY a.warehouse_code,a.source_wh,a.source_order,a.sku
), asn_execution_keys AS (
 SELECT a.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code,a.source_wh AS source_wh,a.source_order AS source_order,a.sku AS sku
 FROM asn_orders AS a GROUP BY a.warehouse_code,a.source_wh,a.source_order,a.sku
), asn_execution_lines AS (
 SELECT k.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code,k.source_wh AS source_wh,k.source_order AS source_order,k.sku AS sku,
 e.executeorderno AS execute_order,e.executeorderlineno AS line_no,MAX(e.material_name) AS material_name,
 MAX(e.prapare_order_status) AS prepare_status,MAX(e.wms_close_time) AS shipped_at,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=1 AND MIN(e.qtyallocated)>=0 AND MIN(e.bizunitconvertrate)>0 THEN MAX(e.qtyallocated/e.bizunitconvertrate) END AS allocated,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=1 AND MIN(e.qtyshipped)>=0 AND MIN(e.bizunitconvertrate)>0 THEN MAX(e.qtyshipped/e.bizunitconvertrate) END AS shipped
 FROM asn_execution_keys AS k INNER JOIN agents_scm_execute_detail_hourly_d AS e
 ON e.fromorderno=k.source_order AND e.receive_wh=k.warehouse_code AND e.warehouseid=k.source_wh AND e.material_code=k.sku
 WHERE e.order_type='ZUB' AND e.detailstatus=10 AND NULLIF(TRIM(e.canceltime),'') IS NULL AND NULLIF(TRIM(e.dmscanceltime),'') IS NULL
 GROUP BY k.warehouse_code,k.source_wh,k.source_order,k.sku,e.executeorderno,e.executeorderlineno
), asn_execution AS (
 SELECT e.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code,e.source_wh AS source_wh,e.source_order AS source_order,e.sku AS sku,
 MAX(e.material_name) AS material_name,MAX(e.shipped_at) AS shipped_at,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT e.prepare_status)=1 THEN MAX(e.prepare_status) END AS prepare_status,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(e.allocated)=COUNT(*) THEN SUM(e.allocated) END AS allocated,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(e.shipped)=COUNT(*) THEN SUM(e.shipped) END AS shipped
 FROM asn_execution_lines AS e GROUP BY e.warehouse_code,e.source_wh,e.source_order,e.sku
), upstream_raw_lines AS (
 SELECT a.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code,a.warehouse_name AS warehouse_name,b.base AS base,
 COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(a.source_order),''),a.fallback_no) AS order_no,a.sku AS line_no,a.sku AS sku,
 e.material_name AS material_name,a.created_at AS created_at,a.requested_at AS requested_at,
 e.shipped_at AS completed_at,a.asn_closed_at AS closed_at,
 CASE WHEN a.asn_status='00' THEN '待收货' ELSE '已收货' END AS order_status,
 a.asn_status AS asn_status,e.prepare_status AS prepare_status,a.expected AS expected_total,a.received AS received_total,
 CASE WHEN e.allocated IS NOT NULL AND a.expected IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN e.allocated>a.expected THEN a.expected ELSE e.allocated END END AS allocated_total,
 a.source_updated_at AS source_updated_at,CASE WHEN a.invalid=0 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS source_rows,
 CASE WHEN a.expected IS NULL OR a.received IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN a.expected>a.received THEN a.expected-a.received ELSE 0 END AS ordered,
 CASE WHEN e.allocated IS NULL OR a.expected IS NULL OR a.received IS NULL THEN NULL
 WHEN e.allocated<=a.received THEN 0 WHEN e.allocated>=a.expected THEN CASE WHEN a.expected>a.received THEN a.expected-a.received ELSE 0 END ELSE e.allocated-a.received END AS allocated,
 CASE WHEN e.shipped IS NULL OR a.expected IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN e.shipped>a.expected THEN a.expected ELSE e.shipped END AS shipped
 FROM asn_orders AS a LEFT JOIN asn_execution AS e
 ON a.warehouse_code=e.warehouse_code AND a.source_wh=e.source_wh AND a.source_order=e.source_order AND a.sku=e.sku
 LEFT JOIN upstream_base_warehouses AS b ON a.source_wh=b.warehouse_code
 LEFT JOIN upstream_warehouses AS sender ON a.source_wh=sender.warehouse_code
 WHERE sender.warehouse_code IS NULL
), upstream_presence AS (
 SELECT COUNT(*) AS source_count FROM (SELECT 1 AS present FROM agents_scm_asn_detail_d AS a LIMIT 1) AS p
), upstream_open_lines AS (
 SELECT l.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code,l.warehouse_name AS warehouse_name,l.base AS base,
 l.order_no AS order_no,l.line_no AS line_no,l.sku AS sku,l.material_name AS material_name,
 l.created_at AS created_at,l.requested_at AS requested_at,l.order_status AS order_status,
 l.source_updated_at AS source_updated_at,l.ordered AS ordered,l.allocated AS allocated,l.shipped AS shipped,
 l.ordered AS demand,l.allocated AS preparing_allocated,
 CASE WHEN l.ordered IS NULL OR l.allocated IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN l.ordered>l.allocated THEN l.ordered-l.allocated ELSE 0 END AS remaining,
 CASE WHEN l.source_rows<>1 OR l.created_at IS NULL OR l.base IS NULL OR l.sku IS NULL OR l.ordered IS NULL OR l.allocated IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS invalid
 FROM upstream_raw_lines AS l WHERE l.asn_status='00' AND l.closed_at IS NULL AND (l.ordered IS NULL OR l.ordered>0)
), upstream_order_sku AS (
 SELECT l.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code,MAX(l.warehouse_name) AS warehouse_name,l.base AS base,l.order_no AS order_no,l.sku AS sku,
 MAX(l.material_name) AS material_name,MIN(l.created_at) AS created_at,MIN(l.requested_at) AS requested_at,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT l.order_status)=1 THEN MAX(l.order_status) END AS order_status,
 MAX(l.source_updated_at) AS source_updated_at,MAX(l.invalid) AS invalid,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(l.ordered)=COUNT(*) THEN SUM(l.ordered) END AS ordered,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(l.demand)=COUNT(*) THEN SUM(l.demand) END AS demand,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(l.demand)=COUNT(*) THEN SUM(l.demand) END AS preparing_demand,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(l.allocated)=COUNT(*) AND COUNT(l.ordered)=COUNT(*) THEN CASE WHEN SUM(l.allocated)>SUM(l.ordered) THEN SUM(l.ordered) ELSE SUM(l.allocated) END END AS allocated,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(l.preparing_allocated)=COUNT(*) AND COUNT(l.demand)=COUNT(*) THEN CASE WHEN SUM(l.preparing_allocated)>SUM(l.demand) THEN SUM(l.demand) ELSE SUM(l.preparing_allocated) END END AS preparing_allocated,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(l.shipped)=COUNT(*) THEN SUM(l.shipped) END AS shipped,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(l.demand)=COUNT(*) AND COUNT(l.preparing_allocated)=COUNT(*) THEN CASE WHEN SUM(l.demand)>SUM(l.preparing_allocated) THEN SUM(l.demand)-SUM(l.preparing_allocated) ELSE 0 END END AS remaining
 FROM upstream_open_lines AS l GROUP BY l.warehouse_code,l.base,l.order_no,l.sku
), upstream_pool_quality AS (
 SELECT l.base AS base,l.sku AS sku,MAX(l.invalid) AS invalid FROM upstream_order_sku AS l GROUP BY l.base,l.sku
), upstream_preceding AS (
 SELECT l.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code,l.base AS base,l.order_no AS order_no,l.sku AS sku,
 COALESCE(SUM(p.remaining),0) AS prior_remaining
 FROM upstream_order_sku AS l INNER JOIN upstream_pool_quality AS valid_pool ON (l.base=valid_pool.base OR (l.base IS NULL AND valid_pool.base IS NULL)) AND (l.sku=valid_pool.sku OR (l.sku IS NULL AND valid_pool.sku IS NULL)) LEFT JOIN upstream_order_sku AS p ON p.remaining>0 AND (l.base=p.base OR (l.base IS NULL AND p.base IS NULL)) AND (l.sku=p.sku OR (l.sku IS NULL AND p.sku IS NULL))
 AND (p.created_at<l.created_at OR (p.created_at=l.created_at AND p.order_no<l.order_no)
 OR (p.created_at=l.created_at AND p.order_no=l.order_no AND p.warehouse_code<l.warehouse_code))
 WHERE valid_pool.invalid=0 AND l.remaining>0 GROUP BY l.warehouse_code,l.base,l.order_no,l.sku
), upstream_allocation AS (
 SELECT l.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code,l.warehouse_name AS warehouse_name,l.base AS base,l.order_no AS order_no,l.sku AS sku,
 l.material_name AS material_name,l.created_at AS created_at,l.requested_at AS requested_at,l.order_status AS order_status,
 l.source_updated_at AS source_updated_at,l.ordered AS ordered,l.demand AS demand,l.preparing_demand AS preparing_demand,l.allocated AS allocated,
 l.preparing_allocated AS preparing_allocated,l.shipped AS shipped,l.remaining AS remaining,
 CASE WHEN l.invalid=0 AND l.remaining=0 THEN 0 WHEN pr.source_count=0 OR q.invalid<>0 OR s.month_date IS NULL OR bs.base IS NULL OR (b.sku IS NOT NULL AND b.available IS NULL) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS invalid,
 CASE WHEN l.invalid=0 AND l.remaining=0 THEN 0 WHEN pr.source_count>0 AND q.invalid=0 AND s.month_date IS NOT NULL AND bs.base IS NOT NULL AND (b.sku IS NULL OR b.available IS NOT NULL) THEN
 CASE WHEN COALESCE(b.available,0)<=p.prior_remaining THEN 0
 WHEN COALESCE(b.available,0)-p.prior_remaining>=l.remaining THEN l.remaining
 ELSE COALESCE(b.available,0)-p.prior_remaining END END AS available
 FROM upstream_order_sku AS l LEFT JOIN upstream_preceding AS p
 ON l.warehouse_code=p.warehouse_code AND (l.base=p.base OR (l.base IS NULL AND p.base IS NULL)) AND l.order_no=p.order_no AND (l.sku=p.sku OR (l.sku IS NULL AND p.sku IS NULL))
 INNER JOIN upstream_pool_quality AS q ON (l.base=q.base OR (l.base IS NULL AND q.base IS NULL)) AND (l.sku=q.sku OR (l.sku IS NULL AND q.sku IS NULL))
 CROSS JOIN upstream_snapshot AS s CROSS JOIN upstream_presence AS pr LEFT JOIN upstream_base_stock AS b ON l.base=b.base AND l.sku=b.sku LEFT JOIN upstream_bases AS bs ON l.base=bs.base
), upstream_current AS (
 SELECT l.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code,l.warehouse_name AS warehouse_name,l.base AS base,l.order_no AS order_no,l.sku AS sku,
 l.material_name AS material_name,l.created_at AS created_at,l.requested_at AS requested_at,l.order_status AS order_status,
 l.source_updated_at AS source_updated_at,l.ordered AS ordered,l.demand AS demand,l.preparing_demand AS preparing_demand,l.allocated AS allocated,
 l.preparing_allocated AS preparing_allocated,l.shipped AS shipped,l.remaining AS remaining,l.invalid AS invalid,l.available AS available,
 CASE WHEN l.invalid=0 THEN CASE WHEN l.remaining>l.available THEN l.remaining-l.available ELSE 0 END END AS shortage
 FROM upstream_allocation AS l
), fc_order_keys AS (SELECT '分仓' AS location_type, l.warehouse_code AS warehouseid, l.sku AS material_code FROM upstream_order_sku AS l GROUP BY l.warehouse_code, l.sku), source_records AS (SELECT t.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code, t.material_code AS material_code, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.warehouse_name) ELSE NULL END AS warehouse_name, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.material_name) ELSE NULL END AS material_name, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.product_categ_name) ELSE NULL END AS product_categ_name, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.warehouse_month_out_plan) ELSE NULL END AS warehouse_month_out_plan, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.warehouse_future30_qty) ELSE NULL END AS warehouse_future30_qty, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.warehouse_transfer_qty) ELSE NULL END AS warehouse_transfer_qty, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.transfer_onway_qty) ELSE NULL END AS transfer_onway_qty, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.transfer_prepare_qty) ELSE NULL END AS transfer_prepare_qty, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.stat_month) ELSE NULL END AS stat_month, COUNT(*) AS source_rows, '分仓同步表' AS plan_source, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.warehouse_month_transfer_plan) ELSE NULL END AS warehouse_month_transfer_plan, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.last_month_actual_qty) ELSE NULL END AS last_month_actual_qty, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.current_day_avg_qty) ELSE NULL END AS current_day_avg_qty FROM agents_scm_warehouse_transfer_plan_data_d AS t WHERE (:gea_p1 <> 'equal' OR t.warehouse_code = :gea_p2) AND t.stat_month = SUBSTRING(REPLACE(CAST(:gea_p2300 AS VARCHAR(10)), '-', ''), 1, 6) GROUP BY t.warehouse_code, t.material_code), branch_stock_keys AS (SELECT b.warehouseid AS warehouseid, b.material_code AS material_code FROM agents_scm_inventory_sku_data_d AS b WHERE (:gea_p1 <> 'equal' OR b.warehouseid = :gea_p2) AND (b.warehouse_classify = '20' OR b.warehouseid = 'N436') AND b.month_date = REPLACE(CAST(:gea_p2200 AS VARCHAR(10)), '-', '') GROUP BY b.warehouseid, b.material_code), source_keys AS (SELECT s.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code, s.material_code AS material_code FROM source_records AS s UNION ALL SELECT h.warehouseid AS warehouse_code, h.material_code AS material_code FROM branch_stock_keys AS h WHERE NOT NULLIF(TRIM(h.warehouseid), '') IS NULL UNION ALL replenishment.detail.atomic.title: 分仓补货明细与计数同语句
replenishment.detail.atomic.notes: 分仓向基地下单以ASN调拨入库为主体，warehouseid为收货分仓，source_warehouseid关联基地；状态00为未收货、90排除、99完成。按CRM源单号、来源仓、收货分仓和SKU关联基地出库单，出库占用按业务单位转换率换为件；ASN预期及实收原值为件。当前订单为ASN未收货量，基地占用扣除已收货并受当前需求上限约束。缺货按订单剩余需求、基地与SKU共享可用库存计算，按订单创建时间/执行单号/分仓编码稳定先后分配；分仓、SKU、搜索及分页在分配后筛选。缺失或冲突保持未知。 D97：有业务包含当前及次月已发布调拨计划的正值活动；仅判定是否发生业务，不借此换算或填充计划数量；同仓SKU同月重复保持未知。

/* fc-list-interactions:v1 */ WITH quick_transfer_plans AS (SELECT p.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code, p.material_code AS sku, CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=1 THEN MAX(CASE WHEN p.warehouse_month_transfer_plan>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) ELSE NULL END AS has_business FROM agents_scm_warehouse_transfer_plan_data_d AS p WHERE p.stat_month IN (:gea_p3952) GROUP BY p.warehouse_code,p.material_code,p.stat_month), quick_transfer_activity AS (SELECT q.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code,q.sku AS sku,MAX(q.has_business) AS has_business FROM quick_transfer_plans AS q GROUP BY q.warehouse_code,q.sku), list_source AS (WITH fc_branch_scope AS (SELECT b.warehouseid AS warehouse_code FROM agents_scm_inventory_sku_data_d AS b WHERE (:gea_p1 <> 'equal' OR b.warehouseid = :gea_p2) AND (b.warehouse_classify = '20' OR b.warehouseid = 'N436') AND b.month_date = REPLACE(CAST(:gea_p2200 AS VARCHAR(10)), '-', '') AND NOT NULLIF(TRIM(b.warehouseid), '') IS NULL GROUP BY b.warehouseid), upstream_snapshot AS (
 SELECT MAX(i.month_date) AS month_date FROM agents_scm_inventory_sku_data_d AS i
 WHERE i.warehouse_classify IN ('01','02','20')
), latest_inventory AS (SELECT s.month_date AS month_date FROM upstream_snapshot AS s),
upstream_warehouses AS (
 SELECT i.warehouseid AS warehouse_code, MAX(i.warehouse_name) AS warehouse_name
 FROM agents_scm_inventory_sku_data_d AS i INNER JOIN upstream_snapshot AS s ON i.month_date=s.month_date
 WHERE (i.warehouse_classify='20' OR i.warehouseid='N436')
 GROUP BY i.warehouseid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT i.warehouse_name)=1
), upstream_base_batches AS (
 SELECT i.belong_base AS base,i.material_code AS sku,i.warehouseid AS warehouse_code,
 i.prod_date AS prod_date,i.sap_warehouseid AS sap_warehouseid,i.plant AS plant,
 i.quality_batch AS quality_batch,i.is_good_prod AS is_good_prod,i.warehouse_classify AS warehouse_classify,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=1 AND COUNT(i.available_qty)=1 THEN SUM(i.available_qty) END AS available
 FROM agents_scm_inventory_sku_data_d AS i INNER JOIN upstream_snapshot AS s ON i.month_date=s.month_date
 WHERE i.warehouse_classify IN ('01','02') AND i.warehouseid<>'N436'
 GROUP BY i.belong_base,i.material_code,i.warehouseid,i.prod_date,i.sap_warehouseid,i.plant,i.quality_batch,i.is_good_prod,i.warehouse_classify
) , upstream_bases AS (
 SELECT b.base AS base FROM upstream_base_batches AS b GROUP BY b.base
), upstream_base_stock AS (
 SELECT b.base AS base,b.sku AS sku,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(b.available)=COUNT(*) THEN CASE WHEN SUM(b.available)>0 THEN SUM(b.available) ELSE 0 END END AS available
 FROM upstream_base_batches AS b GROUP BY b.base,b.sku
), upstream_base_warehouses AS (
 SELECT b.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code,CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT b.base)=1 THEN MAX(b.base) END AS base
 FROM upstream_base_batches AS b GROUP BY b.warehouse_code
), asn_lines AS (
 SELECT a.warehouseid AS warehouse_code,a.source_warehouseid AS source_wh,a.asnreference1 AS source_order,
 a.asnno AS asn_no,a.asnlineno AS line_no,a.material_code AS sku,
 MAX(a.warehouse_name) AS warehouse_name,MIN(a.header_addtime) AS created_at,
 MIN(a.actualarrivetime) AS requested_at,MAX(a.order_close_time) AS asn_closed_at,MAX(a.asnstatus) AS asn_status,
 MAX(a.lastreceivingtime) AS received_at,MAX(a.load_time) AS source_updated_at,COUNT(*) AS physical_rows,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=1 AND MIN(a.expectedqty)>=0 THEN MAX(a.expectedqty) END AS expected,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=1 AND MIN(a.receivedqty)>=0 THEN MAX(a.receivedqty) END AS received
 FROM agents_scm_asn_detail_d AS a
 WHERE (a.warehouse_classify='20' OR a.warehouseid='N436') AND a.asntype IN ('TT','COMPANY_SALE')
 AND a.asnstatus = '00' AND a.order_close_time IS NULL
 GROUP BY a.warehouseid,a.source_warehouseid,a.asnreference1,a.asnno,a.asnlineno,a.material_code
), asn_orders AS (
 SELECT a.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code,a.source_wh AS source_wh,a.source_order AS source_order,a.sku AS sku,
 MAX(a.warehouse_name) AS warehouse_name,MIN(a.created_at) AS created_at,MIN(a.requested_at) AS requested_at,
 MAX(a.asn_closed_at) AS asn_closed_at,MAX(a.asn_status) AS asn_status,MAX(a.received_at) AS received_at,
 MAX(a.source_updated_at) AS source_updated_at,MIN(a.asn_no) AS fallback_no,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(a.expected)=COUNT(*) THEN SUM(a.expected) END AS expected,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(a.received)=COUNT(*) THEN SUM(a.received) END AS received,
 MAX(CASE WHEN a.physical_rows<>1 OR a.source_order IS NULL OR a.expected IS NULL OR a.received IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS invalid
 FROM asn_lines AS a GROUP BY a.warehouse_code,a.source_wh,a.source_order,a.sku
), asn_execution_keys AS (
 SELECT a.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code,a.source_wh AS source_wh,a.source_order AS source_order,a.sku AS sku
 FROM asn_orders AS a GROUP BY a.warehouse_code,a.source_wh,a.source_order,a.sku
), asn_execution_lines AS (
 SELECT k.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code,k.source_wh AS source_wh,k.source_order AS source_order,k.sku AS sku,
 e.executeorderno AS execute_order,e.executeorderlineno AS line_no,MAX(e.material_name) AS material_name,
 MAX(e.prapare_order_status) AS prepare_status,MAX(e.wms_close_time) AS shipped_at,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=1 AND MIN(e.qtyallocated)>=0 AND MIN(e.bizunitconvertrate)>0 THEN MAX(e.qtyallocated/e.bizunitconvertrate) END AS allocated,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=1 AND MIN(e.qtyshipped)>=0 AND MIN(e.bizunitconvertrate)>0 THEN MAX(e.qtyshipped/e.bizunitconvertrate) END AS shipped
 FROM asn_execution_keys AS k INNER JOIN agents_scm_execute_detail_hourly_d AS e
 ON e.fromorderno=k.source_order AND e.receive_wh=k.warehouse_code AND e.warehouseid=k.source_wh AND e.material_code=k.sku
 WHERE e.order_type='ZUB' AND e.detailstatus=10 AND NULLIF(TRIM(e.canceltime),'') IS NULL AND NULLIF(TRIM(e.dmscanceltime),'') IS NULL
 GROUP BY k.warehouse_code,k.source_wh,k.source_order,k.sku,e.executeorderno,e.executeorderlineno
), asn_execution AS (
 SELECT e.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code,e.source_wh AS source_wh,e.source_order AS source_order,e.sku AS sku,
 MAX(e.material_name) AS material_name,MAX(e.shipped_at) AS shipped_at,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT e.prepare_status)=1 THEN MAX(e.prepare_status) END AS prepare_status,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(e.allocated)=COUNT(*) THEN SUM(e.allocated) END AS allocated,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(e.shipped)=COUNT(*) THEN SUM(e.shipped) END AS shipped
 FROM asn_execution_lines AS e GROUP BY e.warehouse_code,e.source_wh,e.source_order,e.sku
), upstream_raw_lines AS (
 SELECT a.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code,a.warehouse_name AS warehouse_name,b.base AS base,
 COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(a.source_order),''),a.fallback_no) AS order_no,a.sku AS line_no,a.sku AS sku,
 e.material_name AS material_name,a.created_at AS created_at,a.requested_at AS requested_at,
 e.shipped_at AS completed_at,a.asn_closed_at AS closed_at,
 CASE WHEN a.asn_status='00' THEN '待收货' ELSE '已收货' END AS order_status,
 a.asn_status AS asn_status,e.prepare_status AS prepare_status,a.expected AS expected_total,a.received AS received_total,
 CASE WHEN e.allocated IS NOT NULL AND a.expected IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN e.allocated>a.expected THEN a.expected ELSE e.allocated END END AS allocated_total,
 a.source_updated_at AS source_updated_at,CASE WHEN a.invalid=0 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS source_rows,
 CASE WHEN a.expected IS NULL OR a.received IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN a.expected>a.received THEN a.expected-a.received ELSE 0 END AS ordered,
 CASE WHEN e.allocated IS NULL OR a.expected IS NULL OR a.received IS NULL THEN NULL
 WHEN e.allocated<=a.received THEN 0 WHEN e.allocated>=a.expected THEN CASE WHEN a.expected>a.received THEN a.expected-a.received ELSE 0 END ELSE e.allocated-a.received END AS allocated,
 CASE WHEN e.shipped IS NULL OR a.expected IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN e.shipped>a.expected THEN a.expected ELSE e.shipped END AS shipped
 FROM asn_orders AS a LEFT JOIN asn_execution AS e
 ON a.warehouse_code=e.warehouse_code AND a.source_wh=e.source_wh AND a.source_order=e.source_order AND a.sku=e.sku
 LEFT JOIN upstream_base_warehouses AS b ON a.source_wh=b.warehouse_code
 LEFT JOIN upstream_warehouses AS sender ON a.source_wh=sender.warehouse_code
 WHERE sender.warehouse_code IS NULL
), upstream_presence AS (
 SELECT COUNT(*) AS source_count FROM (SELECT 1 AS present FROM agents_scm_asn_detail_d AS a LIMIT 1) AS p
), upstream_open_lines AS (
 SELECT l.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code,l.warehouse_name AS warehouse_name,l.base AS base,
 l.order_no AS order_no,l.line_no AS line_no,l.sku AS sku,l.material_name AS material_name,
 l.created_at AS created_at,l.requested_at AS requested_at,l.order_status AS order_status,
 l.source_updated_at AS source_updated_at,l.ordered AS ordered,l.allocated AS allocated,l.shipped AS shipped,
 l.ordered AS demand,l.allocated AS preparing_allocated,
 CASE WHEN l.ordered IS NULL OR l.allocated IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN l.ordered>l.allocated THEN l.ordered-l.allocated ELSE 0 END AS remaining,
 CASE WHEN l.source_rows<>1 OR l.created_at IS NULL OR l.base IS NULL OR l.sku IS NULL OR l.ordered IS NULL OR l.allocated IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS invalid
 FROM upstream_raw_lines AS l WHERE l.asn_status='00' AND l.closed_at IS NULL AND (l.ordered IS NULL OR l.ordered>0)

request.sql:
WITH upstream_snapshot AS (
 SELECT MAX(i.month_date) AS month_date FROM agents_scm_inventory_sku_data_d AS i
 WHERE i.warehouse_classify IN ('01','02','20')
), latest_inventory AS (SELECT s.month_date AS month_date FROM upstream_snapshot AS s),
upstream_warehouses AS (
 SELECT i.warehouseid AS warehouse_code, MAX(i.warehouse_name) AS warehouse_name
 FROM agents_scm_inventory_sku_data_d AS i INNER JOIN upstream_snapshot AS s ON i.month_date=s.month_date
 WHERE (i.warehouse_classify='20' OR i.warehouseid='N436')
 GROUP BY i.warehouseid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT i.warehouse_name)=1
), upstream_base_batches AS (
 SELECT i.belong_base AS base,i.material_code AS sku,i.warehouseid AS warehouse_code,
 i.prod_date AS prod_date,i.sap_warehouseid AS sap_warehouseid,i.plant AS plant,
 i.quality_batch AS quality_batch,i.is_good_prod AS is_good_prod,i.warehouse_classify AS warehouse_classify,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=1 AND COUNT(i.available_qty)=1 THEN SUM(i.available_qty) END AS available
 FROM agents_scm_inventory_sku_data_d AS i INNER JOIN upstream_snapshot AS s ON i.month_date=s.month_date
 WHERE i.warehouse_classify IN ('01','02') AND i.warehouseid<>'N436'
 GROUP BY i.belong_base,i.material_code,i.warehouseid,i.prod_date,i.sap_warehouseid,i.plant,i.quality_batch,i.is_good_prod,i.warehouse_classify
) , upstream_bases AS (
 SELECT b.base AS base FROM upstream_base_batches AS b GROUP BY b.base
), upstream_base_stock AS (
 SELECT b.base AS base,b.sku AS sku,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(b.available)=COUNT(*) THEN CASE WHEN SUM(b.available)>0 THEN SUM(b.available) ELSE 0 END END AS available
 FROM upstream_base_batches AS b GROUP BY b.base,b.sku
), upstream_base_warehouses AS (
 SELECT b.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code,CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT b.base)=1 THEN MAX(b.base) END AS base
 FROM upstream_base_batches AS b GROUP BY b.warehouse_code
), asn_lines AS (
 SELECT a.warehouseid AS warehouse_code,a.source_warehouseid AS source_wh,a.asnreference1 AS source_order,
 a.asnno AS asn_no,a.asnlineno AS line_no,a.material_code AS sku,
 MAX(a.warehouse_name) AS warehouse_name,MIN(a.header_addtime) AS created_at,
 MIN(a.actualarrivetime) AS requested_at,MAX(a.order_close_time) AS asn_closed_at,MAX(a.asnstatus) AS asn_status,
 MAX(a.lastreceivingtime) AS received_at,MAX(a.load_time) AS source_updated_at,COUNT(*) AS physical_rows,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=1 AND MIN(a.expectedqty)>=0 THEN MAX(a.expectedqty) END AS expected,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=1 AND MIN(a.receivedqty)>=0 THEN MAX(a.receivedqty) END AS received
 FROM agents_scm_asn_detail_d AS a
 WHERE (a.warehouse_classify='20' OR a.warehouseid='N436') AND a.asntype IN ('TT','COMPANY_SALE')
 AND a.asnstatus = '00' AND a.order_close_time IS NULL
 GROUP BY a.warehouseid,a.source_warehouseid,a.asnreference1,a.asnno,a.asnlineno,a.material_code
), asn_orders AS (
 SELECT a.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code,a.source_wh AS source_wh,a.source_order AS source_order,a.sku AS sku,
 MAX(a.warehouse_name) AS warehouse_name,MIN(a.created_at) AS created_at,MIN(a.requested_at) AS requested_at,
 MAX(a.asn_closed_at) AS asn_closed_at,MAX(a.asn_status) AS asn_status,MAX(a.received_at) AS received_at,
 MAX(a.source_updated_at) AS source_updated_at,MIN(a.asn_no) AS fallback_no,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(a.expected)=COUNT(*) THEN SUM(a.expected) END AS expected,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(a.received)=COUNT(*) THEN SUM(a.received) END AS received,
 MAX(CASE WHEN a.physical_rows<>1 OR a.source_order IS NULL OR a.expected IS NULL OR a.received IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS invalid
 FROM asn_lines AS a GROUP BY a.warehouse_code,a.source_wh,a.source_order,a.sku
), asn_execution_keys AS (
 SELECT a.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code,a.source_wh AS source_wh,a.source_order AS source_order,a.sku AS sku
 FROM asn_orders AS a GROUP BY a.warehouse_code,a.source_wh,a.source_order,a.sku
), asn_execution_lines AS (
 SELECT k.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code,k.source_wh AS source_wh,k.source_order AS source_order,k.sku AS sku,
 e.executeorderno AS execute_order,e.executeorderlineno AS line_no,MAX(e.material_name) AS material_name,
 MAX(e.prapare_order_status) AS prepare_status,MAX(e.wms_close_time) AS shipped_at,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=1 AND MIN(e.qtyallocated)>=0 AND MIN(e.bizunitconvertrate)>0 THEN MAX(e.qtyallocated/e.bizunitconvertrate) END AS allocated,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=1 AND MIN(e.qtyshipped)>=0 AND MIN(e.bizunitconvertrate)>0 THEN MAX(e.qtyshipped/e.bizunitconvertrate) END AS shipped
 FROM asn_execution_keys AS k INNER JOIN agents_scm_execute_detail_hourly_d AS e
 ON e.fromorderno=k.source_order AND e.receive_wh=k.warehouse_code AND e.warehouseid=k.source_wh AND e.material_code=k.sku
 WHERE e.order_type='ZUB' AND e.detailstatus=10 AND NULLIF(TRIM(e.canceltime),'') IS NULL AND NULLIF(TRIM(e.dmscanceltime),'') IS NULL
 GROUP BY k.warehouse_code,k.source_wh,k.source_order,k.sku,e.executeorderno,e.executeorderlineno
), asn_execution AS (
 SELECT e.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code,e.source_wh AS source_wh,e.source_order AS source_order,e.sku AS sku,
 MAX(e.material_name) AS material_name,MAX(e.shipped_at) AS shipped_at,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT e.prepare_status)=1 THEN MAX(e.prepare_status) END AS prepare_status,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(e.allocated)=COUNT(*) THEN SUM(e.allocated) END AS allocated,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(e.shipped)=COUNT(*) THEN SUM(e.shipped) END AS shipped
 FROM asn_execution_lines AS e GROUP BY e.warehouse_code,e.source_wh,e.source_order,e.sku
), upstream_raw_lines AS (
 SELECT a.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code,a.warehouse_name AS warehouse_name,b.base AS base,
 COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(a.source_order),''),a.fallback_no) AS order_no,a.sku AS line_no,a.sku AS sku,
 e.material_name AS material_name,a.created_at AS created_at,a.requested_at AS requested_at,
 e.shipped_at AS completed_at,a.asn_closed_at AS closed_at,
 CASE WHEN a.asn_status='00' THEN '待收货' ELSE '已收货' END AS order_status,
 a.asn_status AS asn_status,e.prepare_status AS prepare_status,a.expected AS expected_total,a.received AS received_total,
 CASE WHEN e.allocated IS NOT NULL AND a.expected IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN e.allocated>a.expected THEN a.expected ELSE e.allocated END END AS allocated_total,
 a.source_updated_at AS source_updated_at,CASE WHEN a.invalid=0 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS source_rows,
 CASE WHEN a.expected IS NULL OR a.received IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN a.expected>a.received THEN a.expected-a.received ELSE 0 END AS ordered,
 CASE WHEN e.allocated IS NULL OR a.expected IS NULL OR a.received IS NULL THEN NULL
 WHEN e.allocated<=a.received THEN 0 WHEN e.allocated>=a.expected THEN CASE WHEN a.expected>a.received THEN a.expected-a.received ELSE 0 END ELSE e.allocated-a.received END AS allocated,
 CASE WHEN e.shipped IS NULL OR a.expected IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN e.shipped>a.expected THEN a.expected ELSE e.shipped END AS shipped
 FROM asn_orders AS a LEFT JOIN asn_execution AS e
 ON a.warehouse_code=e.warehouse_code AND a.source_wh=e.source_wh AND a.source_order=e.source_order AND a.sku=e.sku
 LEFT JOIN upstream_base_warehouses AS b ON a.source_wh=b.warehouse_code
 LEFT JOIN upstream_warehouses AS sender ON a.source_wh=sender.warehouse_code

WITH upstream_snapshot AS (
 SELECT MAX(i.month_date) AS month_date FROM agents_scm_inventory_sku_data_d AS i
 WHERE i.warehouse_classify IN ('01','02','20')
), latest_inventory AS (SELECT s.month_date AS month_date FROM upstream_snapshot AS s),
upstream_warehouses AS (
 SELECT i.warehouseid AS warehouse_code, MAX(i.warehouse_name) AS warehouse_name
 FROM agents_scm_inventory_sku_data_d AS i INNER JOIN upstream_snapshot AS s ON i.month_date=s.month_date
 WHERE (i.warehouse_classify='20' OR i.warehouseid='N436')
 GROUP BY i.warehouseid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT i.warehouse_name)=1
), upstream_base_batches AS (
 SELECT i.belong_base AS base,i.material_code AS sku,i.warehouseid AS warehouse_code,
 i.prod_date AS prod_date,i.sap_warehouseid AS sap_warehouseid,i.plant AS plant,
 i.quality_batch AS quality_batch,i.is_good_prod AS is_good_prod,i.warehouse_classify AS warehouse_classify,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=1 AND COUNT(i.available_qty)=1 THEN SUM(i.available_qty) END AS available
 FROM agents_scm_inventory_sku_data_d AS i INNER JOIN upstream_snapshot AS s ON i.month_date=s.month_date
 WHERE i.warehouse_classify IN ('01','02') AND i.warehouseid<>'N436'
 GROUP BY i.belong_base,i.material_code,i.warehouseid,i.prod_date,i.sap_warehouseid,i.plant,i.quality_batch,i.is_good_prod,i.warehouse_classify
) , upstream_bases AS (
 SELECT b.base AS base FROM upstream_base_batches AS b GROUP BY b.base
), upstream_base_stock AS (
 SELECT b.base AS base,b.sku AS sku,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(b.available)=COUNT(*) THEN CASE WHEN SUM(b.available)>0 THEN SUM(b.available) ELSE 0 END END AS available
 FROM upstream_base_batches AS b GROUP BY b.base,b.sku
), upstream_base_warehouses AS (
 SELECT b.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code,CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT b.base)=1 THEN MAX(b.base) END AS base
 FROM upstream_base_batches AS b GROUP BY b.warehouse_code
), asn_lines AS (

 CASE WHEN e.shipped IS NULL OR a.expected IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN e.shipped>a.expected THEN a.expected ELSE e.shipped END AS shipped

 WHERE i.warehouse_classify IN ('01','02') AND i.warehouseid<>'N436'

), asn_lines AS (

 CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=1 AND MIN(a.expectedqty)>=0 THEN MAX(a.expectedqty) END AS expected,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=1 AND MIN(a.receivedqty)>=0 THEN MAX(a.receivedqty) END AS received
 FROM agents_scm_asn_detail_d AS a
 WHERE (a.warehouse_classify='20' OR a.warehouseid='N436') AND a.asntype IN ('TT','COMPANY_SALE')

 GROUP BY a.warehouseid,a.source_warehouseid,a.asnreference1,a.asnno,a.asnlineno,a.material_code
), asn_orders AS (

 MAX(a.asn_closed_at) AS asn_closed_at,MAX(a.asn_status) AS asn_status,MAX(a.received_at) AS received_at,
 MAX(a.source_updated_at) AS source_updated_at,MIN(a.asn_no) AS fallback_no,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(a.expected)=COUNT(*) THEN SUM(a.expected) END AS expected,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(a.received)=COUNT(*) THEN SUM(a.received) END AS received,

), asn_execution_keys AS (

), asn_execution_lines AS (
 SELECT k.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code,k.source_wh AS source_wh,k.source_order AS source_order,k.sku AS sku,
 e.executeorderno AS execute_order,e.executeorderlineno AS line_no,MAX(e.material_name) AS material_name,

 CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=1 AND MIN(e.qtyshipped)>=0 AND MIN(e.bizunitconvertrate)>0 THEN MAX(e.qtyshipped/e.bizunitconvertrate) END AS shipped
 FROM asn_execution_keys AS k INNER JOIN agents_scm_execute_detail_hourly_d AS e

 GROUP BY k.warehouse_code,k.source_wh,k.source_order,k.sku,e.executeorderno,e.executeorderlineno
), asn_execution AS (
 SELECT e.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code,e.source_wh AS source_wh,e.source_order AS source_order,e.sku AS sku,
 MAX(e.material_name) AS material_name,MAX(e.shipped_at) AS shipped_at,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT e.prepare_status)=1 THEN MAX(e.prepare_status) END AS prepare_status,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(e.allocated)=COUNT(*) THEN SUM(e.allocated) END AS allocated,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(e.shipped)=COUNT(*) THEN SUM(e.shipped) END AS shipped
 FROM asn_execution_lines AS e GROUP BY e.warehouse_code,e.source_wh,e.source_order,e.sku
), upstream_raw_lines AS (

 e.material_name AS material_name,a.created_at AS created_at,a.requested_at AS requested_at,
 e.shipped_at AS completed_at,a.asn_closed_at AS closed_at,
 CASE WHEN a.asn_status='00' THEN '待收货' ELSE '已收货' END AS order_status,
 a.asn_status AS asn_status,e.prepare_status AS prepare_status,a.expected AS expected_total,a.received AS received_total,
 CASE WHEN e.allocated IS NOT NULL AND a.expected IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN e.allocated>a.expected THEN a.expected ELSE e.allocated END END AS allocated_total,
 a.source_updated_at AS source_updated_at,CASE WHEN a.invalid=0 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS source_rows,
 CASE WHEN a.expected IS NULL OR a.received IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN a.expected>a.received THEN a.expected-a.received ELSE 0 END AS ordered,
 CASE WHEN e.allocated IS NULL OR a.expected IS NULL OR a.received IS NULL THEN NULL
 WHEN e.allocated<=a.received THEN 0 WHEN e.allocated>=a.expected THEN CASE WHEN a.expected>a.received THEN a.expected-a.received ELSE 0 END ELSE e.allocated-a.received END AS allocated,
 CASE WHEN e.shipped IS NULL OR a.expected IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN e.shipped>a.expected THEN a.expected ELSE e.shipped END AS shipped
 FROM asn_orders AS a LEFT JOIN asn_execution AS e
 ON a.warehouse_code=e.warehouse_code AND a.source_wh=e.source_wh AND a.source_order=e.source_order AND a.sku=e.sku
 LEFT JOIN upstream_base_warehouses AS b ON a.source_wh=b.warehouse_code
 LEFT JOIN upstream_warehouses AS sender ON a.source_wh=sender.warehouse_code
 WHERE sender.warehouse_code IS NULL
), upstream_presence AS (
 SELECT COUNT(*) AS source_count FROM (SELECT 1 AS present FROM agents_scm_asn_detail_d AS a LIMIT 1) AS p
), upstream_open_lines AS (
 SELECT l.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code,l.warehouse_name AS warehouse_name,l.base AS base,
 l.order_no AS order_no,l.line_no AS line_no,l.sku AS sku,l.material_name AS material_name,
 l.created_at AS created_at,l.requested_at AS requested_at,l.order_status AS order_status,
 l.source_updated_at AS source_updated_at,l.ordered AS ordered,l.allocated AS allocated,l.shipped AS shipped,
 l.ordered AS demand,l.allocated AS preparing_allocated,
 CASE WHEN l.ordered IS NULL OR l.allocated IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN l.ordered>l.allocated THEN l.ordered-l.allocated ELSE 0 END AS remaining,
 CASE WHEN l.source_rows<>1 OR l.created_at IS NULL OR l.base IS NULL OR l.sku IS NULL OR l.ordered IS NULL OR l.allocated IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS invalid
 FROM upstream_raw_lines AS l WHERE l.asn_status='00' AND l.closed_at IS NULL AND (l.ordered IS NULL OR l.ordered>0)
), upstream_order_sku AS (
 SELECT l.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code,MAX(l.warehouse_name) AS warehouse_name,l.base AS base,l.order_no AS order_no,l.sku AS sku,
 MAX(l.material_name) AS material_name,MIN(l.created_at) AS created_at,MIN(l.requested_at) AS requested_at,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT l.order_status)=1 THEN MAX(l.order_status) END AS order_status,
 MAX(l.source_updated_at) AS source_updated_at,MAX(l.invalid) AS invalid,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(l.ordered)=COUNT(*) THEN SUM(l.ordered) END AS ordered,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(l.demand)=COUNT(*) THEN SUM(l.demand) END AS demand,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(l.demand)=COUNT(*) THEN SUM(l.demand) END AS preparing_demand,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(l.allocated)=COUNT(*) AND COUNT(l.ordered)=COUNT(*) THEN CASE WHEN SUM(l.allocated)>SUM(l.ordered) THEN SUM(l.ordered) ELSE SUM(l.allocated) END END AS allocated,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(l.preparing_allocated)=COUNT(*) AND COUNT(l.demand)=COUNT(*) THEN CASE WHEN SUM(l.preparing_allocated)>SUM(l.demand) THEN SUM(l.demand) ELSE SUM(l.preparing_allocated) END END AS preparing_allocated,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(l.shipped)=COUNT(*) THEN SUM(l.shipped) END AS shipped,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(l.demand)=COUNT(*) AND COUNT(l.preparing_allocated)=COUNT(*) THEN CASE WHEN SUM(l.demand)>SUM(l.preparing_allocated) THEN SUM(l.demand)-SUM(l.preparing_allocated) ELSE 0 END END AS remaining
 FROM upstream_open_lines AS l GROUP BY l.warehouse_code,l.base,l.order_no,l.sku
), upstream_pool_quality AS (
 SELECT l.base AS base,l.sku AS sku,MAX(l.invalid) AS invalid FROM upstream_order_sku AS l GROUP BY l.base,l.sku
), upstream_preceding AS (
 SELECT l.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code,l.base AS base,l.order_no AS order_no,l.sku AS sku,
 COALESCE(SUM(p.remaining),0) AS prior_remaining
 FROM upstream_order_sku AS l INNER JOIN upstream_pool_quality AS valid_pool ON (l.base=valid_pool.base OR (l.base IS NULL AND valid_pool.base IS NULL)) AND (l.sku=valid_pool.sku OR (l.sku IS NULL AND valid_pool.sku IS NULL)) LEFT JOIN upstream_order_sku AS p ON p.remaining>0 AND (l.base=p.base OR (l.base IS NULL AND p.base IS NULL)) AND (l.sku=p.sku OR (l.sku IS NULL AND p.sku IS NULL))
 AND (p.created_at<l.created_at OR (p.created_at=l.created_at AND p.order_no<l.order_no)
 OR (p.created_at=l.created_at AND p.order_no=l.order_no AND p.warehouse_code<l.warehouse_code))
 WHERE valid_pool.invalid=0 AND l.remaining>0 GROUP BY l.warehouse_code,l.base,l.order_no,l.sku
), upstream_allocation AS (
 SELECT l.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code,l.warehouse_name AS warehouse_name,l.base AS base,l.order_no AS order_no,l.sku AS sku,
 l.material_name AS material_name,l.created_at AS created_at,l.requested_at AS requested_at,l.order_status AS order_status,
 l.source_updated_at AS source_updated_at,l.ordered AS ordered,l.demand AS demand,l.preparing_demand AS preparing_demand,l.allocated AS allocated,
 l.preparing_allocated AS preparing_allocated,l.shipped AS shipped,l.remaining AS remaining,
 CASE WHEN l.invalid=0 AND l.remaining=0 THEN 0 WHEN pr.source_count=0 OR q.invalid<>0 OR s.month_date IS NULL OR bs.base IS NULL OR (b.sku IS NOT NULL AND b.available IS NULL) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS invalid,
 CASE WHEN l.invalid=0 AND l.remaining=0 THEN 0 WHEN pr.source_count>0 AND q.invalid=0 AND s.month_date IS NOT NULL AND bs.base IS NOT NULL AND (b.sku IS NULL OR b.available IS NOT NULL) THEN
 CASE WHEN COALESCE(b.available,0)<=p.prior_remaining THEN 0
 WHEN COALESCE(b.available,0)-p.prior_remaining>=l.remaining THEN l.remaining
 ELSE COALESCE(b.available,0)-p.prior_remaining END END AS available
 FROM upstream_order_sku AS l LEFT JOIN upstream_preceding AS p
 ON l.warehouse_code=p.warehouse_code AND (l.base=p.base OR (l.base IS NULL AND p.base IS NULL)) AND l.order_no=p.order_no AND (l.sku=p.sku OR (l.sku IS NULL AND p.sku IS NULL))
 INNER JOIN upstream_pool_quality AS q ON (l.base=q.base OR (l.base IS NULL AND q.base IS NULL)) AND (l.sku=q.sku OR (l.sku IS NULL AND q.sku IS NULL))
 CROSS JOIN upstream_snapshot AS s CROSS JOIN upstream_presence AS pr LEFT JOIN upstream_base_stock AS b ON l.base=b.base AND l.sku=b.sku LEFT JOIN upstream_bases AS bs ON l.base=bs.base
), upstream_current AS (
 SELECT l.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code,l.warehouse_name AS warehouse_name,l.base AS base,l.order_no AS order_no,l.sku AS sku,
 l.material_name AS material_name,l.created_at AS created_at,l.requested_at AS requested_at,l.order_status AS order_status,
 l.source_updated_at AS source_updated_at,l.ordered AS ordered,l.demand AS demand,l.preparing_demand AS preparing_demand,l.allocated AS allocated,
 l.preparing_allocated AS preparing_allocated,l.shipped AS shipped,l.remaining AS remaining,l.invalid AS invalid,l.available AS available,
 CASE WHEN l.invalid=0 THEN CASE WHEN l.remaining>l.available THEN l.remaining-l.available ELSE 0 END END AS shortage
 FROM upstream_allocation AS l
), upstream_materials AS (SELECT m.material_code AS sku,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(m.product_categ_name),''))=1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(m.product_categ_name),'')) END AS category,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(m.material_group_name),''))=1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(m.material_group_name),'')) END AS material_group
 FROM agents_scm_material_in_out_summary_d AS m GROUP BY m.material_code), current_source AS (SELECT CAST(CONCAT(SUBSTRING(s.month_date,1,4),'-',SUBSTRING(s.month_date,5,2),'-',SUBSTRING(s.month_date,7,2)) AS DATE) AS snapshot_date,
 '分仓' AS location_type,l.warehouse_code AS location_code,l.warehouse_name AS location_name,l.base AS base,
 l.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code,l.sku AS sku,l.material_name AS material_name,m.category AS category,m.material_group AS material_group,
 l.demand AS demand,l.preparing_allocated AS allocated,l.remaining AS remaining,l.available AS available,l.shortage AS shortage,l.invalid AS invalid
 FROM upstream_current AS l CROSS JOIN upstream_snapshot AS s LEFT JOIN upstream_materials AS m ON l.sku=m.sku UNION ALL SELECT CAST(CONCAT(SUBSTRING(s.month_date,1,4),'-',SUBSTRING(s.month_date,5,2),'-',SUBSTRING(s.month_date,7,2)) AS DATE) AS snapshot_date,
 '分仓' AS location_type,w.warehouse_code AS location_code,w.warehouse_name AS location_name,
 CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(255)) AS base,w.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code,CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(255)) AS sku,
 CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(255)) AS material_name,CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(255)) AS category,CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(255)) AS material_group,
 CASE WHEN pr.source_count>0 THEN 0 END AS demand,CASE WHEN pr.source_count>0 THEN 0 END AS allocated,CASE WHEN pr.source_count>0 THEN 0 END AS remaining,CASE WHEN pr.source_count>0 THEN 0 END AS available,CASE WHEN pr.source_count>0 THEN 0 END AS shortage,CASE WHEN s.month_date IS NULL OR pr.source_count=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS invalid
 FROM upstream_warehouses AS w CROSS JOIN upstream_snapshot AS s CROSS JOIN upstream_presence AS pr LEFT JOIN
 (SELECT l.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code FROM upstream_current AS l GROUP BY l.warehouse_code) AS o ON w.warehouse_code=o.warehouse_code
 WHERE o.warehouse_code IS NULL), filtered AS (SELECT r.snapshot_date AS snapshot_date,r.location_type AS location_type,r.location_code AS location_code,r.location_name AS location_name,
 r.base AS base,r.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code,r.sku AS sku,r.material_name AS material_name,r.category AS category,r.material_group AS material_group,

location_code, f.location_name AS location_name, f.base AS base, f.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code, f.sku AS sku, f.material_name AS material_name, f.category AS category, f.material_group AS THEN SUM(f.remaining) END AS remaining, CASE WHEN SUM(f.invalid)=0 THEN SUM(f.available) END AS available, CASE WHEN SUM(f.invalid)=0 THEN SUM(f.shortage) END AS shortage, SUM(f.invalid) AS invalid FROM filtered AS f GROUP BY f.snapshot_date,f.location_type,f.location_code,f.location_name,f.base,f.warehouse_code,f.sku,f.material_name,f.category,f.material_group), page_count AS (SELECT COUNT(*) g.base AS base, g.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code, g.sku AS sku, g.material_name AS material_name, g.category AS category, g.material_group AS material_group, g.demand AS demand, g.allocated AS OFFSET :gea_p5) SELECT p.snapshot_date AS snapshot_date, p.location_type AS location_type, p.location_code AS location_code, p.location_name AS location_name, p.base AS base, p.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code, p.sku AS sku, p.material_name AS material_name, p.category AS category, p.material_group AS material_group, p.demand AS demand, p.allocated AS allocated, p.remaining AS remaining, p.available AS available, p.shortage AS shortage, p.invalid AS invalid,n.page_scope_total AS page_scope_total,p.page_row_present AS page_row_present FROM page_count AS n LEFT JOIN page_rows AS p ON TRUE ORDER BY p.warehouse_code,p.base,p.sku

 e.executeorderno AS execute_order,e.executeorderlineno AS line_no,MAX(e.material_name) AS material_name,
